feat->Instinct.name: Instinto
feat->Instinct.description:
Tú channel tu rage through an instinct. Tú decide what tu instinct means to tú. It could be a criatura or symbol beloved by tu clan, or a purely internal source or filter of tu rage, such as a belief, curse, heritage, or state of mind. Each instinct grants an instinct ability, plus more abilities puedes gain via feats that list that instinct as a prerequisite. It also determines what daño tú resist with raging resistance and, at higher levels, increases the daño adicional tú deal when tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.WZUCvxqbigXos1L9]{Rage}.

Each instinct lists acts that are anathema to it. Siempre que tú perform such acts, tú lose the instinct's abilities and any feats that list tu instinct as a prerequisite until tú spend 1 day of downtime re-centering yourself, though tú keep all of tu other barbarian abilities.

feat->Giant Instinct.name: giant Instinct
feat->Giant Instinct.description:
Tu rage gives tú the raw power and size of a giant. Este doesn't necessarily mean tú revere giants-tú might scoff at them or even aspire to slay them! Tú could instead seem like a giant to other people due to tu exceptional strength or larger-than-life emotions and ego.

Anathema

Failing to face a personal challenge of strength is anathema.

Titan Mauler (Instinct Ability)

Puedes use a arma built for a Large criatura if estás Small or Medium (both normally and when raging). If estás not Small or Medium, puedes use a arma built for a criatura one size larger than tú. Obtienes access to this larger arma, of any arma type otherwise available at character creation. It has the normal Price and Bulk for a arma of its size. When wielding such a arma in combat, increase tu daño adicional from Rage from 2 to 6, but tienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} condition because of the arma's unwieldy size. Puedes't remove this torpe condition or ignore its penalties by any means while wielding the arma.

Specialization AbilityLevel 7

Increase the daño from Rage when using a larger arma from 6 to 10; if tienes greater arma specialization, increase it from 10 to 18.

Raging ResistanceLevel 9

Tú resist daño contundente and tu choice of cold, electricity, or fire, chosen when obtienes raging resistance.

Note: Necesitas to manually apply Clumsy 1 when tú enter rage. Remember to alter the size of tu arma to ensure tu Instinct Ability works correctly.

action->Rage.description:

Tú tap into tu inner fury and begin raging. Obtienes a number of Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to tu level plus tu Constitution modifier. Este frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies puedes perceive, or until tú fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, whichever comes first. Puedes't voluntarily stop raging. While estás raging:

  • Tú deal 2 daño adicional with melee armas and ataques sin armas. Este daño adicional is halved if tu arma or ataque sin armas is agile.
  • Sufres a -1 penalización to AC.
  • Puedes't use actions with the concentrate rasgo unless they also have the rage rasgo. Puedes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} while raging.

After tú stop raging, tú lose any remaining Puntos de Golpe temporales from Rage, and puedes't Rage again for 1 minute.

Aumentar sus rangos de competencia en Intimidación, Sigilo y Supervivencia a entrenado, y si ya estaba entrenado en una de esas habilidades.de su tipo, aumenta su rango de competencia en esa habilidad a experto. Si tu acompañante es Mediano o más pequeño, crece una talla.

action->Overdrive.description:

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Temporarily cranking the gizmos on tu body into overdrive, tú try to add greater power to tu attacks. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:@self.level] check that has a standard DC for tu level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1XlJ9xLzL19GHoOL]{Efecto: Overdrive}

Éxito crítico Tu gizmos go into a state of incredible efficiency called critical overdrive, adding great power to tu attacks. Tu Golpes deal daño adicional equal to tu INTELLIGENCE modifier for 1 minute. After the Overdrive ends, tu gizmos become unusable as they cool down or reset, and puedes't use Overdrive for 1 minute.

Éxito Tu gizmos go into overdrive, adding power to tu attacks. As critical success, except the daño adicional is equal to half tu INTELLIGENCE modifier.

Fallo Tu gizmos whine concerningly and begin to smoke. Tu Golpes deal 1 daño adicional de fuego.

Fallo crítico Whoops! Something explodes. Sufres daño de fuego equal to half tu level (rounded up), and puedes't use Overdrive again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Overdrive]] rounds as tu gizmos reset.

Special When under the effects of Overdrive, puedes still use the Overdrive action. Puedes't extend tu Overdrive's duration this way, but puedes turn an overdrive into a critical overdrive if tú critically succeed. A failure has no effect on tu current Overdrive, and tú end tu Overdrive on a critical failure.

feat->Construct Innovation.name: Construir innovación
feat->Construct Innovation.description:
Tu innovation is a mechanical criatura, such as a clockwork construct made of cogs and gears. It's a prototype construct companion, and puedes adjust most of its base statistics by taking feats at higher levels, such as Advanced Companion. If tú use the Overdrive action, tu construct gains the same Overdrive benefits tú do, and it also takes the same amount of daño de fuego on a critical failure.

Tú know how to spend additional time directing, controlling, or programming tu construct innovation for a more complex plan of action. Puedes spend 2 actions to comando instead of 1 when commanding tu construct companion; tu construct companion can then use an additional action (normally 3 actions, rather than 2).

Elige one initial construct modification to apply to tu innovation, either from the following or from other initial construct modifications to which tienes access. Estos modifications alter the construct's abilities or form.

  • Accelerated Mobility Actuated legs, efficient gears in the wheels or treads, or add-on boosters make tu construct faster. Tu innovation's Velocidad increases to 40 pies.
  • Amphibious Construction Increased buoyancy, rudders, and a means of propulsion like a fluked tail or powerful propeller make tu construct able to travel in water. Tu innovation gains a swim Velocidad of 25 pies.
  • Increased Size Tú built tu construct innovation bigger than most. Tu construct is Large. If tienes this modification and tu construct innovation becomes an advanced construct companion or otherwise gains the ability to become Large, puedes immediately change increased size to a different initial construct modification.
  • Manual Dexterity Tu construct innovation has articulated hands or similar appendages with significant manual dexterity. It can perform manipulate actions with up to two of its limbs. As normal for a companion, it still can't wield armas or held items that don't have the companion rasgo, and it can't activate items.
  • Projectile Launcher Tu construct has a mounted dart launcher, embedded cannon, or similar armament. Tu innovation gains a ranged ataque sin armas that deals 1d4 bludgeoning or daño perforante (tú elige when tú pick this modification). The attack has the propulsive rasgo and a range increment of 30 pies.
  • Sensory Array Additional sensory devices give tu innovation low-light vision and darkvision, as well as imprecise tremorsense out to a range of 30 pies.
  • Wonder Gears Tú map specialized skills into tu construct's crude INTELLIGENCE. Tu innovation becomes entrenado in INTIMIDATION, STEALTH, and SURVIVAL.

feat->Inventor Weapon Expertise.name: Experiencia en armas del inventor
feat->Inventor Weapon Expertise.description:
Tú develop tricks for using tu armas more effectively. Tu proficiency ranks for simple and martial armas and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

If tienes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.bok3P78CMchFibxC]{Weapon Innovation}, obtienes access to the critical specialization effect with tu innovation.

feat->Arcane School.name: Escuela arcana
feat->Arcane School.description:
Most wizards acquire their knowledge of conjuros from a formal educational institution, such as the Arcanamirium or the Magaambya. At 1st level, tú elige tu arcane school, which grants tú magical abilities.

Obtienes additional conjuros and conjuro slots from the curriculum taught at the school tú attended. Arcane schools are described in detail on page 198. Some wizards follow the school of unified magical theory, which attempts to forge a new school by studying independently and drawing information from a multitude of texts and tutors. Though a wizard with this approach lacks the focus of formal training, they have greater flexibility.

feat->Arcane Thesis.name: Tesis arcana
feat->Arcane Thesis.description: During tu studies to become a full-fledged wizard, tú produced a thesis of unique magical research. Obtienes a special benefit depending on the topic of tu thesis research. The arcane thesis topics presented in this book are below; tu specific thesis probably has a much longer and more technical title like "On the Methods of Spell Interpolation and the Genesis of a New Understanding of the Building Blocks of Magic."

feat->Arcane Bond.name: Vínculo arcano
feat->Arcane Bond.description: Tú place some of tu magical power in a bonded item. Each day when tú prepare tu conjuros, puedes designate a single item tú own as tu bonded item. Este is typically an item associated with spellcasting, such as a wand, ring, or staff, but estás free to designate a arma or other item. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} free action.

feat->Wizard Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros del mago
feat->Wizard Spellcasting.description:
Through dedicated study and practice, puedes construct conjuros with academic rigor by shaping arcane magic. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the arcane tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a wizard, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations likely specify exactly what forces tú call on and how to shape them, and tu gestures precisely shape and direct tu magic while circles of arcane runes flare to life.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros in tu spellbook (see below), as well as one extra curriculum cantrip and one extra curriculum conjuro of each rank puedes cast from tu arcane school. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a wizard, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the wizard Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Details on calculating these statistics appear on page 403.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of wizard conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level wizard, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level wizard, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

Spellbook

Every arcane conjuro has a written version, which tú record in tu personalized book of conjuros. Tú start with a spellbook worth 10 sp or less, which tú receive for free and must study each day to prepare tu conjuros. Tu spellbook's form and name are up to tú. It might be a musty, leather-bound tome or an assortment of thin metal disks connected to a brass ring; its name might be esoteric, like The Tome of Silent Shadows or something more academic, like Advanced Pyromantic Applications of Jalmeri Elemental Theory.

The spellbook contains tu choice of 10 arcane cantrips and five 1st-rank arcane conjuros. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the arcane conjuro list or from other arcane conjuros obtienes access to. Tú also add two 1st-rank conjuros from the curriculum of tu arcane school (except in the case of the school of unified magical theory, as described in that school).

Each time obtienes a level, tú add two arcane conjuros to tu spellbook, of any conjuro rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to and learn via Learn a Spell. When obtienes conjuro slots of a new rank, tú also add an additional conjuro from tu school's curriculum (unless it's the school of unified magical theory).

feat->School of Unified Magical Theory.name: Escuela de Teoría Mágica Unificada
feat->School of Unified Magical Theory.description:
Tú eschew the idea that magic can be neatly expressed by the teachings of any single school or college, instead directing tu self-study to pick up the best of every school of magic. In doing so, tú'll find the truths that lie at the intersection of each school, coming closer to the ideal NATURE of arcane magic. One day, tú'll uncover that single elegant theory detailing all magic (perhaps a theory bearing tu name?), but until then, tu studies continue.

No Curriculum Tú don't have a set curriculum, and so tú don't have curriculum conjuros and can't benefit from abilities that specifically affect them. In doing so, tú'll find the truths that lie at the intersection of each school, coming closer to the ideal NATURE of arcane magic. One day, tú'll uncover that single elegant theory detailing all magic (perhaps a theory bearing tu name?), but until then, tu studies continue.

No Curriculum Tú don't have a set curriculum, and so tú don't have curriculum conjuros and can't benefit from abilities that specifically affect them. Instead, obtienes an additional 1st-level wizard class feat, and tú add one 1st-rank conjuro of tu choice to tu spellbook to represent tu diverse studies.

Tu studies into the very NATURE of magic itself have let tú use it more efficiently—instead of using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} only una vez al día, puedes use it una vez al día for each rank of conjuro puedes cast, recalling a conjuro of that rank each time.

feat->Patron.name: Patrón
feat->Patron.description:
Tú weren't born with the power to cast conjuros, nor have tú spent years dedicated to worship, study, or uncovering mystical secrets. Tu magic instead has been gifted to tú by a potent being, one who knows that by empowering tú so, tú'll further the being's agenda in the world, whatever it may be. Este entity is typically mysterious and distant, revealing little of their identity and motivations. They make their will known to tú in abstract signs such as omens, dreams, or similar subtleties rather than words.

Rather than interacting with tú directly, tu patron works through a familiar—a mystical criatura that teaches tú, serves as the conduit for tu patron's magic, and maybe even keeps an eye on tú to ensure estás furthering tu patron's nebulous ends.

At 1st level, elige tu patron, which determines tu spellcasting tradition and grants tú the skill for that tradition of magic, tu first witch's lesson and a unique familiar ability.

feat->Familiar (Witch).name: Familiar (brujo)
feat->Familiar (Witch).description:
Tu patron has sent tú a familiar, a mystical criatura that teaches tú magic and facilitates tu conjuros. Este familiar follows the rules for familiars, though as it's a direct conduit between tú and tu patron, it's more powerful than typical familiars. Tu familiar gains two additional familiar abilities: one of these is a unique ability based on tu patron and is always selected, and the other is an additional familiar ability that can be selected daily as normal. Tu familiar gains another extra ability at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

Spells: Tu familiar is the source and repository of the conjuros tu patron has bestowed upon tú, and debes commune with tu familiar to prepare tu conjuros each day using tu witch spellcasting. Tu familiar starts off knowing 10 cantrips, five 1st-rank conjuros, and one additional conjuro determined by tu patron's initial lesson. Tú elige these conjuros from the common conjuros of the tradition determined by tu patron or from other conjuros of that tradition obtienes access to. Each time obtienes a level, tu patron teaches tu familiar two new conjuros of any rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to. Feats can also grant tu familiar additional conjuros.

Learning Spells: Tu familiar can learn new conjuros independently of tu patron. It can learn any conjuro on tu tradition's conjuro list by physically consuming a written version of that conjuro over the course of 1 hour. Este can be a scroll of that conjuro, or puedes prepare a written version using the Learn a Spell exploration activity. Tú and tu familiar can use the Learn a Spell activity to teach tu familiar a conjuro from another witch's familiar. Both familiars must be present for the entirety of the activity, the conjuro must be on tu spellcasting tradition's conjuro list, and debes pay the usual cost for that activity, typically in the form of an offering to the other familiar's patron. Puedes't prepare conjuros from another witch's familiar.

Undying: If tu familiar dies, tu patron replaces it during tu next daily preparations. The new familiar might be a duplicate or reincarnation of tu former familiar or a new entity altogether, but it knows the same conjuros tu former familiar knew regardless. Tu familiar's death doesn't affect any conjuros tienes already prepared.

feat->Hex Spells.name: Maleficios
feat->Hex Spells.description:
As a favored agent of tu patron, puedes invoke their power for a more direct magical intervention. A hex is a conjuro shaped by tu patron and sent to tú through tu familiar, rather than an ability tú use directly. Tu patron expects tú to advance its interests and does not take kindly to repeated requests for aid; as such, puedes use only one hex each turn, and any attempts to use a second hex on that turn fail and the actions are lost.

Hex conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with tu familiar.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but it can never be more than 3 points.

Aprendes tu choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet} hex or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} hex, which let tú command tu familiar or defend it from harm, respectively. Aprendes most other hexes from witch lessons.

Hex Cantrips

Hex cantrips are special hexes that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes cast them as often as tú like, though puedes still use only one hex each round. Hex cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with witch spellcasting and aren't counted toward tu prepared cantrips.

Obtienes a hex cantrip determined by tu choice of patron.

feat->Witch Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de brujo
feat->Witch Spellcasting.description:
Using tu familiar as a conduit, tu patron provides tú the power to cast conjuros. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of tu patron's tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a witch, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations might rhyme, tu gestures might be as simple as an ominous pointing finger or a complex folk sign, and tu familiar might even echo tu words or movements slightly as tu patron's magic surges.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros tu familiar knows. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots. As tú increase in level as a witch, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the Witch Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd-rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witch conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level witch, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level witch, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->The Resentment.name: El resentimiento
feat->The Resentment.description:
A single feeling radiated from tu patron in the moment tú met them, as palpable as heat from a fire: the desire to see every tall poppy felled and every proud nail hammered down, whether to righteously bring justice for small folk or the base urge to see the powerful defeated. Tu patron is likely far from the upper echelons of its kind, such as a hag ousted from its coven or a quasi-divinity or a lower-rank demon. Este leaves it only subtler and weaker tools to see its ends met: curses, hexes, and tú.

Spell List occult

Patron Skill OCCULTISM

Lesson of Strength's Impermanence Tu patron has taught tú that power can be taken much more easily that it can be built. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f45JpY7Ph2cAJGW2]{Evil Eye} hex cantrip and tu familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}.

Familiar of Ongoing Misery Tu familiar seems hostile to all criaturas other than tú, hissing at them if they get too near. When tú Cast or Sustain a hex, tu familiar can curse a criatura within 15 pies of it, prolonging the duration of any negative conditions affecting it by 1 round. Este is a curse effect. Este prolongs only conditions with a timed duration (such as "1 round" or "until the end of tu next turn") and doesn't prevent conditions from being removed by other means.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd-rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witch conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level witch, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level witch, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Familiar (Witch).name: Familiar (brujo)
feat->Familiar (Witch).description:
Tu patron has sent tú a familiar, a mystical criatura that teaches tú magic and facilitates tu conjuros. Este familiar follows the rules for familiars, though as it's a direct conduit between tú and tu patron, it's more powerful than typical familiars. Tu familiar gains two additional familiar abilities: one of these is a unique ability based on tu patron and is always selected, and the other is an additional familiar ability that can be selected daily as normal. Tu familiar gains another extra ability at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

Spells: Tu familiar is the source and repository of the conjuros tu patron has bestowed upon tú, and debes commune with tu familiar to prepare tu conjuros each day using tu witch spellcasting. Tu familiar starts off knowing 10 cantrips, five 1st-rank conjuros, and one additional conjuro determined by tu patron's initial lesson. Tú elige these conjuros from the common conjuros of the tradition determined by tu patron or from other conjuros of that tradition obtienes access to. Each time obtienes a level, tu patron teaches tu familiar two new conjuros of any rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to. Feats can also grant tu familiar additional conjuros.

Learning Spells: Tu familiar can learn new conjuros independently of tu patron. It can learn any conjuro on tu tradition's conjuro list by physically consuming a written version of that conjuro over the course of 1 hour. Este can be a scroll of that conjuro, or puedes prepare a written version using the Learn a Spell exploration activity. Tú and tu familiar can use the Learn a Spell activity to teach tu familiar a conjuro from another witch's familiar. Both familiars must be present for the entirety of the activity, the conjuro must be on tu spellcasting tradition's conjuro list, and debes pay the usual cost for that activity, typically in the form of an offering to the other familiar's patron. Puedes't prepare conjuros from another witch's familiar.

Undying: If tu familiar dies, tu patron replaces it during tu next daily preparations. The new familiar might be a duplicate or reincarnation of tu former familiar or a new entity altogether, but it knows the same conjuros tu former familiar knew regardless. Tu familiar's death doesn't affect any conjuros tienes already prepared.

feat->Hex Spells.name: Maleficios
feat->Hex Spells.description:
As a favored agent of tu patron, puedes invoke their power for a more direct magical intervention. A hex is a conjuro shaped by tu patron and sent to tú through tu familiar, rather than an ability tú use directly. Tu patron expects tú to advance its interests and does not take kindly to repeated requests for aid; as such, puedes use only one hex each turn, and any attempts to use a second hex on that turn fail and the actions are lost.

Hex conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with tu familiar.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but it can never be more than 3 points.

Aprendes tu choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet} hex or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} hex, which let tú command tu familiar or defend it from harm, respectively. Aprendes most other hexes from witch lessons.

Hex Cantrips

Hex cantrips are special hexes that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes cast them as often as tú like, though puedes still use only one hex each round. Hex cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with witch spellcasting and aren't counted toward tu prepared cantrips.

Obtienes a hex cantrip determined by tu choice of patron.

feat->Patron.name: Patrón
feat->Patron.description:
Tú weren't born with the power to cast conjuros, nor have tú spent years dedicated to worship, study, or uncovering mystical secrets. Tu magic instead has been gifted to tú by a potent being, one who knows that by empowering tú so, tú'll further the being's agenda in the world, whatever it may be. Este entity is typically mysterious and distant, revealing little of their identity and motivations. They make their will known to tú in abstract signs such as omens, dreams, or similar subtleties rather than words.

Rather than interacting with tú directly, tu patron works through a familiar—a mystical criatura that teaches tú, serves as the conduit for tu patron's magic, and maybe even keeps an eye on tú to ensure estás furthering tu patron's nebulous ends.

At 1st level, elige tu patron, which determines tu spellcasting tradition and grants tú the skill for that tradition of magic, tu first witch's lesson and a unique familiar ability.

feat->Magical Fortitude.name: Fortaleza mágica
feat->Magical Fortitude.description:
Oracle, sorcerer, wizard Magical power has improved tu body's resiliency. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to experto.

Witch Tu patron's power boosts tu physical resiliency. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to experto.

feat->The Resentment.name: El resentimiento
feat->The Resentment.description:
A single feeling radiated from tu patron in the moment tú met them, as palpable as heat from a fire: the desire to see every tall poppy felled and every proud nail hammered down, whether to righteously bring justice for small folk or the base urge to see the powerful defeated. Tu patron is likely far from the upper echelons of its kind, such as a hag ousted from its coven or a quasi-divinity or a lower-rank demon. Este leaves it only subtler and weaker tools to see its ends met: curses, hexes, and tú.

Spell List occult

Patron Skill OCCULTISM

Lesson of Strength's Impermanence Tu patron has taught tú that power can be taken much more easily that it can be built. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f45JpY7Ph2cAJGW2]{Evil Eye} hex cantrip and tu familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}.

Familiar of Ongoing Misery Tu familiar seems hostile to all criaturas other than tú, hissing at them if they get too near. When tú Cast or Sustain a hex, tu familiar can curse a criatura within 15 pies of it, prolonging the duration of any negative conditions affecting it by 1 round. Este is a curse effect. Este prolongs only conditions with a timed duration (such as "1 round" or "until the end of tu next turn") and doesn't prevent conditions from being removed by other means.

feat->Lesson of Life.name: Lección de vida
feat->Lesson of Life.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fAlzXtQAASaJx0mY]{Life Boost} hex, and tu familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yHujiDQPdtXW797e]{Spirit Link}.

spell->Pet Cache.target: 1 willing criatura that is tu animal companion or familiar

consumable->Scroll of Invisibility (Rank.name: Scroll of Invisibility (Rank 2)
consumable->Scroll of Invisibility (Rank.consumableSpellDescription:
Illusions bend light around el objetivo, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. Este makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} to all criaturas, though the criaturas can attempt to find el objetivo, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} to them instead. If el objetivo uses a hostile action, the conjuro ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The conjuro lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if el objetivo uses a hostile action.

Lanzando un conjuro from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Lanzar un conjuro activity using the normal number of actions for that conjuro.

The conjuro must appear on tu conjuro list. Because estás the one Casting the Spell, use tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC. The conjuro also gains the appropriate rasgo for tu tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

consumable->Wand of Soothe (Rank 1).name: Wand of Soothe (Rank 1)
consumable->Wand of Soothe (Rank 1).consumableSpellDescription:
Tú grace el objetivo's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. El objetivo regains 1d10+4 Puntos de Golpe when tú Lanzar el conjuro and gains a +2 bonificador de estado to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuro-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Efecto: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]

A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; characters of the alchemist class typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for tú to copy them into a specific book as long as puedes keep them on hand to reference them.

feat->Alchemy.name: Alquimia
feat->Alchemy.description:
Tú understand the reactions between all manner of reagents and can concoct alchemical items to meet tu needs. Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use specially prepared chemicals that allow tú to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tú advance in power dramatically, leaving behind those who don't understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, and puedes automatically identify alchemical items that tienes the formula for.

feat->Research Field.name: Campo De Investigacion
feat->Research Field.description: Tu inquiries into the alchemical NATURE of the universe have led tú to focus on a particular field of research. At 1st level, tú elige tu research field. Este choice gives tú more formulas, a special benefit, other abilities for tu versatile vials, and other benefits as tú level up.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item they can create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book} for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to any formulas tú gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automatically, but it's also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} skill feat so puedes invent them.

As normal, having the base formula is sufficient when CRAFTING upgraded types of the item—tú don't need to learn higher-level formulas. For instance, if tienes the 1st-level formula for a minor elixir of life, puedes create a minor, lesser, moderate, greater, major, or true elixir of life as long as tú meet the level and other prerequisites. Items with type entries that have widely varied functions require separate formulas, but most alchemical items have a structure similar to elixir of life.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, tú spend some time to create alchemical items that can be used over the course of the day.

Tú don't need to attempt a CRAFTING check to do this, puedes use an alchemist's toolkit instead of an alchemist's lab, and tú ignore both the number of days typically required to create the items and any alchemical raw materials requirements.

Puedes Craft a number of alchemical items up to 4 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Each item must be in tu formula book, have an item level equal to or lower than tu level, and have the consumable rasgo.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent for 24 hours or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

feat->Versatile Vials.name: Viales versátiles
feat->Versatile Vials.description:
Tú know how to prepare fast-acting chemicals into versatile vials, special items that can be used as bombs and be turned into other alchemical items by introducing special reagents. During tu daily preparations, puedes create a number of versatile vials up to 2 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier, which is also tu maximum number of vials. If estás below tu maximum number, puedes gather reagents from the environment around tú. For every 10 minutes tú spend in exploration mode, tú regain 2 vials; this doesn't prevent tú from participating in other exploration activities.

Versatile vials are infused items, and are destroyed if not used by the next time tú make tu daily preparations. A vial tú create is always the highest type tú could Craft. See the sidebar for statistics on using a versatile vial as a bomb. Puedes also use vials for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} and tu research field can add to the ways puedes use a vial.

Puedes store all tu versatile vials within tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.4ftXXUCBHcf4b0MH]{alchemist's Toolkit}, with no increase to its Bulk. Though versatile vials are physical objects, they can't be duplicated or preserved in any way.

feat->Quick Alchemy.name: Alquimia rápida
feat->Quick Alchemy.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} action to make the items necesitas on the fly.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent reactions.

Formulas Two common 1st-level alchemical bombs.

Field Beneficio When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes elige to deal daño de salpicadura to only tu primary target instead of the usual splash area.

Field Vials When tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Golpe} with a versatile vial, puedes elige to have it deal cold, electricity, or daño de fuego instead of daño de ácido.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery} (5th) Tienes calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash. When tú throw an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes cause the bomb to deal daño de salpicadura equal to tu INTELLIGENCE modifier (minimum 1) instead of the normal amount.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5FnyPYPaRbJthT3I]{Advanced Vials} (11th) Puedes mix special ingredients into tu vials, such as magical dust or flakes of precious minerals. When tú create a versatile vial, puedes elige to have it treated as one special material of tu choice, chosen from adamantine, cold iron, and dawnsilver. If estás wearing or wielding an item of a different precious material when tú make the vial, puedes elige that material instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RGs4uR3CAvgbtBAA]{Greater Field Discovery} (13th) Puedes increase the splash on tu bombs to daño criaturas within 10 pies, or 15 pies if tienes Expanded Splash.

Activar 1 Golpe

The bright blue liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed daño de frío and daño de salpicadura de frío. On a hit, el objetivo takes a penalización de estado to its Velocidades until the end of its next turn.

Obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque, la bomba causa 2d6 daño de frío and 2 daño de salpicadura de frío, and el objetivo takes a –10-pies penalización.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.LdmzgBOTjCete4F7]{Efecto: Frost Vial}

feat->Alchemy.name: Alquimia
feat->Alchemy.description:
Tú understand the reactions between all manner of reagents and can concoct alchemical items to meet tu needs. Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use specially prepared chemicals that allow tú to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tú advance in power dramatically, leaving behind those who don't understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, and puedes automatically identify alchemical items that tienes the formula for.

feat->Research Field.name: Campo De Investigacion
feat->Research Field.description: Tu inquiries into the alchemical NATURE of the universe have led tú to focus on a particular field of research. At 1st level, tú elige tu research field. Este choice gives tú more formulas, a special benefit, other abilities for tu versatile vials, and other benefits as tú level up.

feat->Field Discovery.name: Descubrimiento de campo
feat->Field Discovery.description: Aprendes a discovery listed in tu research field.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item they can create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book} for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to any formulas tú gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automatically, but it's also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} skill feat so puedes invent them.

As normal, having the base formula is sufficient when CRAFTING upgraded types of the item—tú don't need to learn higher-level formulas. For instance, if tienes the 1st-level formula for a minor elixir of life, puedes create a minor, lesser, moderate, greater, major, or true elixir of life as long as tú meet the level and other prerequisites. Items with type entries that have widely varied functions require separate formulas, but most alchemical items have a structure similar to elixir of life.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, tú spend some time to create alchemical items that can be used over the course of the day.

Tú don't need to attempt a CRAFTING check to do this, puedes use an alchemist's toolkit instead of an alchemist's lab, and tú ignore both the number of days typically required to create the items and any alchemical raw materials requirements.

Puedes Craft a number of alchemical items up to 4 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Each item must be in tu formula book, have an item level equal to or lower than tu level, and have the consumable rasgo.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent for 24 hours or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

feat->Versatile Vials.name: Viales versátiles
feat->Versatile Vials.description:
Tú know how to prepare fast-acting chemicals into versatile vials, special items that can be used as bombs and be turned into other alchemical items by introducing special reagents. During tu daily preparations, puedes create a number of versatile vials up to 2 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier, which is also tu maximum number of vials. If estás below tu maximum number, puedes gather reagents from the environment around tú. For every 10 minutes tú spend in exploration mode, tú regain 2 vials; this doesn't prevent tú from participating in other exploration activities.

Versatile vials are infused items, and are destroyed if not used by the next time tú make tu daily preparations. A vial tú create is always the highest type tú could Craft. See the sidebar for statistics on using a versatile vial as a bomb. Puedes also use vials for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} and tu research field can add to the ways puedes use a vial.

Puedes store all tu versatile vials within tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.4ftXXUCBHcf4b0MH]{alchemist's Toolkit}, with no increase to its Bulk. Though versatile vials are physical objects, they can't be duplicated or preserved in any way.

feat->Quick Alchemy.name: Alquimia rápida
feat->Quick Alchemy.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} action to make the items necesitas on the fly.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent reactions.

Formulas Two common 1st-level alchemical bombs.

Field Beneficio When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes elige to deal daño de salpicadura to only tu primary target instead of the usual splash area.

Field Vials When tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Golpe} with a versatile vial, puedes elige to have it deal cold, electricity, or daño de fuego instead of daño de ácido.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery} (5th) Tienes calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash. When tú throw an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes cause the bomb to deal daño de salpicadura equal to tu INTELLIGENCE modifier (minimum 1) instead of the normal amount.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5FnyPYPaRbJthT3I]{Advanced Vials} (11th) Puedes mix special ingredients into tu vials, such as magical dust or flakes of precious minerals. When tú create a versatile vial, puedes elige to have it treated as one special material of tu choice, chosen from adamantine, cold iron, and dawnsilver. If estás wearing or wielding an item of a different precious material when tú make the vial, puedes elige that material instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RGs4uR3CAvgbtBAA]{Greater Field Discovery} (13th) Puedes increase the splash on tu bombs to daño criaturas within 10 pies, or 15 pies if tienes Expanded Splash.

feat->Powerful Alchemy.name: Alquimia poderosa
feat->Powerful Alchemy.description: Alchemical items tú infuse are particularly potent. When tú create an infused alchemical item that allows a tirada de salvación, puedes change its DC to tu CLASS DC.

feat->Taunt.name: Pulla
feat->Taunt.description: Often, the best way to protect tu allies is to have the enemigo want to attack tú instead. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt} action.

feat->Guardian's Techniques.name: Técnicas de Guardián
feat->Guardian's Techniques.description:
As a guardian, tienes learned certain techniques to help keep tu allies safe.

Ever Ready

Tú always gain a reaction siempre que tú roll initiative for combat, but puedes use it only for reactions from guardian feats or class features. The GM might still rule that puedes use other reactions before tu first turn based on the situation, as normal.

Intercept Attack

Tú keep tu charges safe from harm, even if it means tú get hurt yourself. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} reaction.

feat->Guardian's Armor.name: Armadura del Guardián
feat->Guardian's Armor.description: Even when estás struck, tu armor protects tú from some harm. While wearing medium or heavy armor, obtienes resistance to daño físico equal to 1 + half tu level. In addition, puedes rest normally while wearing medium and heavy armor.

feat->Iivlar Weaving.name: Tejido Iivlar
feat->Iivlar Weaving.description: Planar thread produced by criaturas called iivlars is woven into tu skin. Este thread glows with dim light in a 10-pies emanation. Puedes Sustain to extinguish, reactivate, or adjust the coloration of this light.

feat->Weapon Expertise.description:
champion, Exemplar, Investigator, Magus Has dedicated yourself to learning the intricacies of tu armas. Tu proficiency ranks for simple armas, martial armas, and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

druid, Kineticist Has improved tu combat skill. Tu proficiency rank for simple armas and ataques sin armas increases to experto.

Guardian Sometimes, the best defense is a good offense. Tu proficiency ranks for simple armas, martial armas, and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

Witch, wizard Through sheer experience, has improved tu technique with tu armas. Tu proficiency ranks for simple armas and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

feat->Clan Dagger.name: Daga de clan
feat->Clan Dagger.description: Tú get one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.kJJvKm80KwWXPukV]{Clan Dagger} of tu clan for free, as it was given to tú at birth. Selling this dagger is a terrible taboo and earns tú the disdain of other dwarves.

feat->Hunter's Edge.description:

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]

Tú Zancada up to tu Velocidad. During this movement, puedes try to move through the space of one enemigo. Attempt an Acrobatics check against the enemigo's Reflex DC as soon as tú try to enter its space. Puedes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} using CLIMB, Fly, Swim, or another action instead of Zancada in the appropriate environment.

Éxito Tú move through the enemigo's space, treating the squares in its space as difficult terrain (every 5 pies costs 10 pies of movement). If tú don't have enough Velocidad to move all the way through its space, tú get the same effect as a failure.

Fallo Tu movement ends, and tú trigger reactions as if tú had moved out of the square tú started in.

feat->Confident Finisher.name: Rematador seguro
feat->Confident Finisher.description:
Obtienes an elegant finishing attack puedes make when tienes panache. The finisher rasgo is described below. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.K878asDgf1EF0B9S]{Confident Finisher} action.

Finisher Finishers are spectacular finishing moves that use tu panache. Finishers can be used only with armas that deal daño adicional with precise strike (agile or finesse melee armas or ataques sin armas, for most swashbucklers). Puedes use a finisher only if tienes panache, and tú lose tu panache immediately after performing a finisher. Once tú use a finisher, puedes't use actions that have the attack rasgo for the rest of tu turn.

Some finisher actions also grant an effect on a failure. Effects added on a failure don't apply on a critical failure. If tu finisher action succeeds, puedes still elige to apply the failure effect instead. For example, tú might do this when an attack deals no daño due to resistance.

feat->Swashbuckler's Style.name: Estilo de espadachín
feat->Swashbuckler's Style.description: Tu own distinctive style lets tú gracefully handle any situation. Elige a swashbuckler's style. Este style determines the additional actions tú use to gain panache and makes tú entrenado in the skill related to that action.

feat->Fencer.name: Esgrimidor
feat->Fencer.description: Tú move carefully, feinting and creating false openings to lead tu foes into inopportune attacks. Estás entrenado in DECEPTION. When tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, the action gains the bravado rasgo.

feat->Panache.name: Estilo
feat->Panache.description:
Tú care as much about the way tú accomplish something as whether tú actually accomplish it in the first place. When tú perform an action with particular style, puedes leverage this moment of verve to perform spectacular, deadly maneuvers. Este heightened state of flair is called panache.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{Efecto: Panache}

Obtienes panache by performing actions that have the bravado rasgo. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and additional actions determined by tu swashbuckler's style gain the bravado rasgo when tú use them. The GM might determine that a check to perform a particularly daring action, such as swinging on a chandelier or sliding down a drapery, can gain the bravado rasgo. Estos checks typically involve at least a single action and a non-trivial DC. Normally, obtienes and use panache only in combat encounters; when an encounter ends, tú lose panache.

Powerful finisher actions, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.K878asDgf1EF0B9S]{Confident Finisher}, can be used only while tienes panache and cause tú to lose tu panache.

feat->Precise Strike.name: Precise Golpe
feat->Precise Strike.description:

feat->Mystery.name: Misterio
feat->Mystery.description:
An oracle wields divine power, but not from a single divine being. Este power could come from a potent concept or ideal, the attention of multiple divine entities whose areas of concern all touch on that subject, or a direct and dangerous conduit to raw divine power. Este is the oracle's mystery, a source of divine magic not beholden to any deity.

Elige the mystery that empowers tu magic. Tu mystery grants tú additional conjuros, and special focus conjuros called revelation conjuros. Tu mystery also gives tú a unique cursebound ability that lets tú draw upon the divine, as well as dictating the effects of the oracular curse that falls upon tú when tú touch too much of this power.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qvRlih3u7vK3FYUR]{Ancestors} Voices of past generations teach and haunt tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gjOGOR30Czpnx3tM]{Battle} Tú embody the virtues upheld by heroes of legend.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.IaxmCkdsPlA52spu]{Bones} Death always seems near, and the dead speak to tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RI2EMRBBPNSoTJXu]{Cosmos} Extraes power from the stars and the spaces between.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GTSvbFb36InvuH0w]{Flames} Tú dance with fire and do tu best to remain unscorched by it.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.o1gGG36wpn9mxeop]{Life} The teeming energies of life flow through tú out into the world.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tZBb3Kh4nJcNoUFI]{LORE} Obtienes access to unparalleled, overwhelming knowledge.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.W9cF7wZztLDb1WGY]{Tempest} Wind, waves, and storms rage at tu beck and call.

Reading a Mystery Entry

A mystery entry contains the following information, followed by a description of that mystery's curse.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in Spell Repertoire on page 130. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast oracle conjuros of that rank.

Revelation Spells Tú automatically gain tu mystery's initial revelation conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Revelation, Greater Revelation, and Diverse Mystery oracle feats. Estos conjuros start on page 259.

Related Domains Estos are the cleric domains associated with tu mystery. Obtienes domain conjuros, which puedes cast as revelation conjuros, by taking the Domain Acumen and Domain Fluency feats. At 11th level, the divine access class feature also gives tú additional slotted conjuros based on tu domains. The domains and their domain conjuros appear on page 372 of Player Core. Domains marked with an asterisk (*) are found in Pathfinder Lost Omens Divine Mysteries.

Mystery Skill Quedas entrenado in the listed skill. A few mysteries make tú entrenado in more than one skill.

Oracle Feat Obtienes this 1st-level oracle feat. Este is a cursebound feat, so using it aggravates tu oracular curse.

The fury of the wind and waves pounds in tu heart, whether tu power flows from natural storms, a conduit to the elemental Planes of Air and Water, or through reverence of deities such as Gozreh, the tengu god of storms Hei Feng, the pirate queen Besmara, or the elemental lords of air and water.

feat->Curse of Inclement Headwinds.name: Maldicion de los vientos contrarios inclementes
feat->Curse of Inclement Headwinds.description:
The weather seems to always oppose tú in ways large and small. Even when estás calm and at rest, tu hair and clothing are inconveniently blown about by gentle winds, estás slightly damp from the faintest drizzle, and tu touch often comes with a static shock. When tienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, estás opposed by the elements, with the following effects.

Cursebound 1 Lightning is drawn to tú. Obtienes electricity weakness 2 and electricity conjuros or effects that have additional effects for a criatura wearing or holding metal treat tú as though tú were wearing metal. Any immunity or resistance tienes to such conjuros and effects is suppressed.

Cursebound 2 Blowing winds impose a -2 penalización de circunstancia to ranged tiradas de ataque tú make.

Cursebound 3 Tu weakness to electricity is equal to 5 + tu level.

Cursebound 4 The raging winds push tú back, imposing a –10-pies penalización de estado to all tu Velocidades.

feat->Spell Repertoire.name: Repertorio de conjuros
feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Oracle Spellcasting.description:
Tienes an unfiltered connection to the great powers of the universe and the planes beyond, and puedes let this power spill forth in the form of divine magic. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As an oracle, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations may spill from tu lips rapidly as tú speak in tongues or intone in a voice not quite tu own, and tu gestures might be wild and unrestrained as religious ecstasy briefly touches tu mind.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as an oracle, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the Oracle Spells per Day table (shown below).

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifiers and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of oracle conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level oracle, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level oracle, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Oracular Curse.name: Maldición oracular
feat->Oracular Curse.description:
As an oracle, puedes tap into the pure and unmitigated divine power of creation to supplement tu spellcasting via cursebound abilities. Estos abilities grant tú special benefits, but the backlash of letting this power into tu mortal body manifests as an oracular curse. The more cursebound abilities tú use, the more tu curse worsens, but tú might gain divine benefits even as it tightens its grip on tu soul.

Tu oracular curse is expressed using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, a unique condition that affects only oracles. Immediately after the first time tú use a cursebound ability, tú become cursebound 1, and if tú use a cursebound ability while estás already cursebound, tú increase the value of tu cursebound condition by 1 after the ability resolves. At lower levels, puedes tolerate only a modest amount of divine power, and tu cursebound condition can't increase beyond cursebound 2; as tú grow in levels, puedes open yourself to even more power and tu cursebound condition can progress to 3 and finally 4. Once saturated in divine power, tu soul can't absorb any more, and so puedes't use a cursebound ability if estás already at tu maximum cursebound condition.

Tu oracular curse lists the specific effects of being cursebound, which are cumulative as tu curse progresses. Tú remain cursebound until tú Refocus, which reduces tu cursebound condition by 1 in addition to restoring a Focus Point. As tu curse is a direct result of divine power, tú cannot mitigate, reduce, or remove the effects of tu curse or any ability with the cursebound rasgo by any means other than Refocusing. For example, if a cursebound effect makes criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from tú, puedes't negate that concealed condition through a magic item or conjuro, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} (though tú would still benefit from the other effects of that item or conjuro). Likewise, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} and similar abilities don't affect tu curse at all.

At 1st level, obtienes a cursebound oracle feat determined by tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PRJYLksQEwT39bTl]{Mystery}, and puedes learn additional cursebound abilities through oracle feats.

The Cursebound Condition

Tu oracular curse is constricting around tú as tú receive divine punishment after drawing too deeply on tu mystery's powers. Cursebound is a condition that affects only criaturas with an oracular curse, and cursebound always includes a value. Tu specific oracular curse imposes unique negative effects depending on tu cursebound value. Puedes remove the cursebound condition only by Refocusing.

feat->Revelation Spells.description:
The powers of tu mystery manifest in the form of revelation conjuros. Revelation conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to search for omens in a way befitting tu mystery, like gazing into a fire, throwing bones and seeing how they fall, or meditating to hear the voices of those who came before tú.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros.

The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but it can never be more than 3 points.

Aprendes a revelation conjuro at 1st level and start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Este conjuro is an initial revelation conjuro determined by tu mystery. Puedes learn additional revelation conjuros through oracle feats.

feat->Oracle Spellcasting.description:
Tienes an unfiltered connection to the great powers of the universe and the planes beyond, and puedes let this power spill forth in the form of divine magic. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As an oracle, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations may spill from tu lips rapidly as tú speak in tongues or intone in a voice not quite tu own, and tu gestures might be wild and unrestrained as religious ecstasy briefly touches tu mind.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as an oracle, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the Oracle Spells per Day table (shown below).

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifiers and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of oracle conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level oracle, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level oracle, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Oracular Curse.name: Maldición oracular
feat->Oracular Curse.description:
As an oracle, puedes tap into the pure and unmitigated divine power of creation to supplement tu spellcasting via cursebound abilities. Estos abilities grant tú special benefits, but the backlash of letting this power into tu mortal body manifests as an oracular curse. The more cursebound abilities tú use, the more tu curse worsens, but tú might gain divine benefits even as it tightens its grip on tu soul.

Tu oracular curse is expressed using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, a unique condition that affects only oracles. Immediately after the first time tú use a cursebound ability, tú become cursebound 1, and if tú use a cursebound ability while estás already cursebound, tú increase the value of tu cursebound condition by 1 after the ability resolves. At lower levels, puedes tolerate only a modest amount of divine power, and tu cursebound condition can't increase beyond cursebound 2; as tú grow in levels, puedes open yourself to even more power and tu cursebound condition can progress to 3 and finally 4. Once saturated in divine power, tu soul can't absorb any more, and so puedes't use a cursebound ability if estás already at tu maximum cursebound condition.

Tu oracular curse lists the specific effects of being cursebound, which are cumulative as tu curse progresses. Tú remain cursebound until tú Refocus, which reduces tu cursebound condition by 1 in addition to restoring a Focus Point. As tu curse is a direct result of divine power, tú cannot mitigate, reduce, or remove the effects of tu curse or any ability with the cursebound rasgo by any means other than Refocusing. For example, if a cursebound effect makes criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from tú, puedes't negate that concealed condition through a magic item or conjuro, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} (though tú would still benefit from the other effects of that item or conjuro). Likewise, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} and similar abilities don't affect tu curse at all.

At 1st level, obtienes a cursebound oracle feat determined by tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PRJYLksQEwT39bTl]{Mystery}, and puedes learn additional cursebound abilities through oracle feats.

The Cursebound Condition

Tu oracular curse is constricting around tú as tú receive divine punishment after drawing too deeply on tu mystery's powers. Cursebound is a condition that affects only criaturas with an oracular curse, and cursebound always includes a value. Tu specific oracular curse imposes unique negative effects depending on tu cursebound value. Puedes remove the cursebound condition only by Refocusing.

The powers of tu mystery manifest in the form of revelation conjuros. Revelation conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to search for omens in a way befitting tu mystery, like gazing into a fire, throwing bones and seeing how they fall, or meditating to hear the voices of those who came before tú.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros.

The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but it can never be more than 3 points.

Aprendes a revelation conjuro at 1st level and start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Este conjuro is an initial revelation conjuro determined by tu mystery. Puedes learn additional revelation conjuros through oracle feats.

feat->Oracular Curse.name: Maldición oracular
feat->Oracular Curse.description:
As an oracle, puedes tap into the pure and unmitigated divine power of creation to supplement tu spellcasting via cursebound abilities. Estos abilities grant tú special benefits, but the backlash of letting this power into tu mortal body manifests as an oracular curse. The more cursebound abilities tú use, the more tu curse worsens, but tú might gain divine benefits even as it tightens its grip on tu soul.

Tu oracular curse is expressed using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, a unique condition that affects only oracles. Immediately after the first time tú use a cursebound ability, tú become cursebound 1, and if tú use a cursebound ability while estás already cursebound, tú increase the value of tu cursebound condition by 1 after the ability resolves. Once saturated in divine power, tu soul can't absorb any more, and so puedes't use a cursebound ability if estás already at tu maximum cursebound condition.

Tu oracular curse lists the specific effects of being cursebound, which are cumulative as tu curse progresses. Tú remain cursebound until tú Refocus, which reduces tu cursebound condition by 1 in addition to restoring a Focus Point. As tu curse is a direct result of divine power, tú cannot mitigate, reduce, or remove the effects of tu curse or any ability with the cursebound rasgo by any means other than Refocusing. For example, if a cursebound effect makes criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from tú, puedes't negate that concealed condition through a magic item or conjuro, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} (though tú would still benefit from the other effects of that item or conjuro). Likewise, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} and similar abilities don't affect tu curse at all.

Tu specific oracular curse imposes unique negative effects depending on tu cursebound value. Puedes remove the cursebound condition only by Refocusing.

If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy obtienes the rasgo automatically. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all cleric spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual.

As a bard, tú select one muse at 1st level. Este muse leads tú to great things and might be someone tú know, a supernatural criatura, location, deity, philosophy, or captivating mystery. Depending on the type of inspiration tú receive, tu 1st-level muse grants tú a specific 1st-level bard feat and adds a conjuro to tu repertoire.

In addition to this, each muse opens the door to many later bard feats. If one type of inspiration is not enough to represent tu muse, consider the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.a898miJnjgD93ZsX]{Multifarious Muse} feat.

feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tú to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tú like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with bard spellcasting. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu allies' attacks, daño, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes usually play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as it takes at least one of tu hands to do so. If tú use an instrument, tú don't need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes usually also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.
