Repertorio de conjuros
feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-level conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher levels.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Maestro.name: Maestro
feat->Maestro.description:
Tu muse constantly inspires tú to greater heights of artistic prowess. For many bards, a teacher or rival fills this role, although some set their sights higher and attempt to surpass great composers of the past or blaze a new trail entirely. If tu muse is a supernatural criatura, it might be one who loves to perform, such as a choral angel or a lyrakien azata; if a deity, it might be Shelyn. Art inspired by a maestro muse is precise and inventive, a formalist achievement.

As a bard with a maestro muse, estás an inspiration to tu allies and confident of tu musical and oratorical abilities.

feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tú to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tú like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with bard spellcasting. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu allies' attacks, daño, and defense against fear.

As a bard, tú select one muse at 1st level. Este muse leads tú to great things and might be someone tú know, a supernatural criatura, location, deity, philosophy, or captivating mystery. Depending on the type of inspiration tú receive, tu 1st-level muse grants tú a specific 1st-level bard feat and adds a conjuro to tu repertoire.

In addition to this, each muse opens the door to many later bard feats. If one type of inspiration is not enough to represent tu muse, consider the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.a898miJnjgD93ZsX]{Multifarious Muse} feat.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros of the occult tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity.

As a bard, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations might be musical riffs or clever limericks, tu gestures might incorporate dance and dramatic pantomiming, and tú might accompany tu spellcasting by playing a musical instrument.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Maestro.name: Maestro
feat->Maestro.description:
Tu muse constantly inspires tú to greater heights of artistic prowess. For many bards, a teacher or rival fills this role, although some set their sights higher and attempt to surpass great composers of the past or blaze a new trail entirely. If tu muse is a supernatural criatura, it might be one who loves to perform, such as a choral angel or a lyrakien azata; if a deity, it might be Shelyn. Art inspired by a maestro muse is precise and inventive, a formalist achievement.

As a bard with a maestro muse, estás an inspiration to tu allies and confident of tu musical and oratorical abilities.

Upon becoming a druid, tú align yourself with a druidic order, which grants tú a class feat, an order conjuro (see below), and an additional entrenado skill tied to tu order While tú'll always be a member of tu initial order, it's not unheard of for a druid to request to study with other orders in search of greater understanding of the natural world, and PC druids are among the most likely to blend the powers of different orders.

Order conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. feat->Anathema (Druid).name: Anatema (druida)
feat->Anathema (Druid).description:
As stewards of the natural order, druids find affronts to NATURE anathema. If tú repeatedly perform these acts, tú lose tu magical abilities from the druid class, including tu druid spellcasting and the benefits of tu order. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual. The following acts are anathema to all druids.

Anathema despoil natural places, consume more natural resources than tú require to live comfortably, teach the Wildsong to non-druids.

Tu choice of druidic order adds further anathema, as detailed in the order's entry.

feat->Druid Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de druida
feat->Druid Spellcasting.description:
The power of the wild world flows through tú. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros of the primal tradition using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lanzar un conjuro} activity. As a druid, tu spellcasting incantations might be pleas to the environment around tú or the invocation of ancient vows; tu hands might sway like willows or curl into clawlike shapes as tu gestures direct tu magic. At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the primal conjuro list, or from other primal conjuros to which obtienes access and learn via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a druid, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the druid Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of druid conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level druid, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and a 5th-level druid's are 3rd rank.

feat->Wildsong.name: Canción salvaje
feat->Wildsong.description: Tú know the Wildsong, a secret language known only within druid orders, in addition to any languages tú know through tu ancestry. The Wildsong is a melodic and tonal language sounding more like animal calls than a spoken tongue, and its alphabet involves fractals and spirals, like the arrangement of a seashell's chambers, a snowflake's crystals, or a fern's fronds. Teaching the Wildsong to non-druids is anathema.

feat->Anathema (Druid).name: Anatema (druida)
feat->Anathema (Druid).description:
As stewards of the natural order, druids find affronts to NATURE anathema. If tú repeatedly perform these acts, tú lose tu magical abilities from the druid class, including tu druid spellcasting and the benefits of tu order. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual. The following acts are anathema to all druids.

Anathema despoil natural places, consume more natural resources than tú require to live comfortably, teach the Wildsong to non-druids.

Tu choice of druidic order adds further anathema, as detailed in the order's entry.

feat->Druid Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de druida
feat->Druid Spellcasting.description:
The power of the wild world flows through tú. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros of the primal tradition using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lanzar un conjuro} activity. As a druid, tu spellcasting incantations might be pleas to the environment around tú or the invocation of ancient vows; tu hands might sway like willows or curl into clawlike shapes as tu gestures direct tu magic. At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the primal conjuro list, or from other primal conjuros to which obtienes access and learn via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a druid, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the druid Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of druid conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level druid, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and a 5th-level druid's are 3rd rank.

feat->Wildsong.name: Canción salvaje
feat->Wildsong.description: Tú know the Wildsong, a secret language known only within druid orders, in addition to any languages tú know through tu ancestry. The Wildsong is a melodic and tonal language sounding more like animal calls than a spoken tongue, and its alphabet involves fractals and spirals, like the arrangement of a seashell's chambers, a snowflake's crystals, or a fern's fronds. Teaching the Wildsong to non-druids is anathema.

feat->Animal Order.description:
Tienes a strong connection to beasts, always feeling like tú understood them (and they tú) better than tu own people. Tú stand for the animals of NATURE, a powerful animal companion at tu side.

feat->Druidic Order.name: Orden druídica
feat->Druidic Order.description:
Upon becoming a druid, tú align yourself with a druidic order, which grants tú a class feat, an order conjuro (see below), and an additional entrenado skill tied to tu order While tú'll always be a member of tu initial order, it's not unheard of for a druid to request to study with other orders in search of greater understanding of the natural world, and PC druids are among the most likely to blend the powers of different orders.

Order conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with local NATURE spirits or otherwise tend to the wilderness in a way befitting tu order.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but can never be more than 3 points.

Order Skill Quedas entrenado in the listed skill. If estás already entrenado in that skill, tú become entrenado in a different skill of tu choice.

druid Feat Obtienes this 1st-level druid feat as a bonus feat.

Order Spell Tú automatically gain the listed order conjuro at 1st level.

feat->Weapon Tricks.description: Obtienes experto proficiency in simple armas, martial armas, and ataques sin armas. When tú critically succeed at an tirada de ataque against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criatura while using an agile or finesse arma or an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, tú apply the critical specialization effect for that arma or ataque sin armas.

feat->Thief.name: Ladrón
feat->Thief.description:
Nothing beats the thrill of taking something that belongs to someone else. Tú might be a pickpocket working the streets, a cat burglar sneaking through windows, or even a consultant, testing tu clients' vaults for openings.

When a fight breaks out, tú prefer swift, lightweight armas, and tú strike where it hurts. When tú attack with a finesse melee arma or finesse melee ataque sin armas, puedes add tu Dexterity modifier to tiradas de daño instead of tu Strength modifier.

Estás entrenado in THIEVERY.

0.label: Contra los efectos de las emociones

1.text: Si obtienes un éxito en una tirada de salvación contra un efecto de emoción, obtendrás un éxito crítico.

2.text: No tratas a un 1 natural como peor de lo habitual en las pruebas de percepción; obtienes una falla crítica solo si tu resultado es 10 menor que el DC.

3.text: No tratas a un 1 natural como peor de lo habitual en las pruebas de habilidad; obtienes una falla crítica solo si tu resultado es 10 menor que el DC.

consumable->Healing Potion (Minor).description:
Activar A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain [[/r 1d8[healing]]]{1d8 Puntos de Golpe}.

feat->First Implement and Esoterica.name: Primer Implemento y Esoterismo
feat->First Implement and Esoterica.description:
Tu implement is a special object of symbolic importance: tu badge as tú treat with the supernatural and a powerful tool if things turn violent. Elige an implement from the options presented below:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PoclGJ7BCEyIuqJe]{Amulet}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DK1LCE5pd0YCY11c]{Bell}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.1vgFGSnn0DIBmK7j]{Chalice}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.AltwHU7hCqTwpn48]{Lantern}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.N6KvTbaRsphc0Ymb]{Mirror}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DhdLzrcMvB93Rjmt]{Regalia}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.84GDSAXaMKMTg2IT]{Shield}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.MyN1cQgE0HsLF20e]{Tome}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.pDxdE8S8QJV2PGiB]{Wand}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.YiDkrwaxiF7Gao7y]{Weapon}

Tú begin play with a mundane item of that type, and obtienes the initiate benefit for that implement. While an implement is useful to tú, it typically has no value if sold. If tú acquire a new object of the same general implement type, puedes switch tu implement to the new object by spending 1 day of downtime with the new item. As tú advance as a thaumaturge, tú will collect up to three implements and unlock the hidden potential stored within each, so puedes mix and match their benefits to suit tu situation.

While tu implements are tu primary tools in tu dealings with the supernatural, tú know the value of always being prepared. Tú constantly collect and carry various smaller mystic objects, bits of materials with paranormal affinities, and items used in folk practices: tu esoterica. Estos might include cold-iron nails, scraps of scrolls and scriptures, fragments of bones purportedly from a saint, and other similar objects. Tú keep tu esoterica in easy-to-access places on tu person and are well practiced in brandishing tu implement and esoterica together, so puedes draw and use esoterica with the same hand estás using to wield an implement.

Exploit Vulnerability

Tú know that every criatura, no matter how obscure, has a weakness. By identifying and empowering the right object, puedes strike down even the most resilient of monsters. Obtienes the Exploit Vulnerability action.

Puedes attempt to Exploit Vulnerabilities in one of two ways: either by invoking properties that repel that type of criatura, or by attempting a more improvisational, ad-hoc method with tu esoterica that can impose a custom weakness on any criatura, albeit one that usually isn't as dire as a criatura's existing weakness.

  • Mortal Weakness After identifying a criatura's weakness, tú use a thematically resonant bit of esoterica to attune tu attacks to tu discovery. Tu unarmed and arma Golpes activate the highest weakness tú discovered with Exploit Vulnerability, even though the tipo de daño tu arma deals doesn't change. Este daño affects el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability, as well as any other criaturas of the exact same type, but not other criaturas with the same weakness. For example, when fighting a pack of werewolves, tú might use silver shavings or crushed moonstone to deal daño that applies their weakness to silver to tu attacks against any of the werewolves, but tú wouldn't apply this daño to any other monsters with a weakness to silver.
  • Personal Antithesis Tú improvise a custom weakness on a criatura by forcefully presenting and empowering a piece of esoterica that repels it on an individual level; for instance, against a tyrant, tú might procure a broken chain that once held a captive. Este causes el objetivo criatura, and only el objetivo criatura, to gain a weakness against tu unarmed and arma Golpes equal to 2 + half tu level.

feat->Esoteric Lore.name: Conocimiento esotérico
feat->Esoteric Lore.description:
Tu experience with the unknown has taught tú about strange phenomena of every kind. Quedas entrenado in Esoteric LORE, a special LORE skill that can be used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} regarding haunts, curses, and criaturas of any type, but that can't be used to Recall Knowledge of other topics. Unlike a normal LORE skill, tú use Charisma as tu modifier on Esoteric LORE checks. Tú also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.

At 3rd level, tú become an experto in Esoteric LORE; at 7th level, tú become a maestro in Esoteric LORE; and at 15th level, tú become legendario in Esoteric LORE.

feat->Lantern.name: Linterna
feat->Lantern.description:
Lantern implements shine the light of revelation to part shadows and expose truth. Tú might use a common glass lantern, torch, paper lantern, or other similar light source. Lantern implements are associated with the harrow suit of stars and the astrological signs of the lantern bearer and the archer.

Initiate Beneficio

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tBI15UqeQH7PLzAK inline]

Adept Beneficio

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QK5ojonup9AQBg4O inline]

Intensify Vulnerability

Tu lantern's light flares and burns bright, leaving no shadows in which secrets and enemies can hide. The emanation of tu lantern's aura doubles in size. Against el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability, the status bonuses from the lantern's initiate benefit increase to +2. The criatura takes a –2 penalización de estado to DECEPTION checks and STEALTH checks as long as it's within the aura. Additionally, el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} while it's in the lantern's aura, though it still can potentially become hidden or undetected using cover or means other than the concealed condition.

Paragon Beneficio

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.k9d3rDhYnHwLI8XF inline]

feat->Initiate Beneficio (Lantern).name: Beneficio de iniciado (Linterna)
feat->Initiate Beneficio (Lantern).description:
While tú hold tu lantern, its burning light leaves secrets no place to hide. Puedes light or extinguish tu lantern with nothing but a thought, as a free action that has the concentrate rasgo. While lit, the lantern emits an aura of light in a 20-pies emanation; the aura has the light and magical rasgos. Everything in the aura is magically lit with bright light regardless of cover, and dim light extends beyond the aura an additional distance equal to the size of the aura. The aura's counteract rank against magical darkness is equal to half tu level rounded up.

The lantern's aura attempts to reveal the unseen. Tú and tu allies in the lantern's aura gain a +1 bonificador de estado to visual Perception checks to notice anything that is also within the aura and a +1 bonificador de estado to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} against criaturas within the aura, as the light exposes their true natures. During exploration, even if tú aren't Searching, the GM rolls a secret check for tú to find traps, environmental hazards, haunts, and secrets (such as secret doors). The GM rolls each time a given hazard or secret comes within the lantern's aura. Estos effects have the magical and revelation rasgos.

feat->Implement's Empowerment.name: Empoderamiento del implemento
feat->Implement's Empowerment.description: The power of tu implement can also be turned to the more common task of combat, its power adding to and amplifying the effects of runes and other magical empowerments. When tú Golpe, puedes trace mystic patterns with an implement estás holding to empower the Golpe, causing it to deal 2 additional Damage per arma dado de daño. Channeling the power requires full use of tu hands. Tú don't gain the benefit of implement's empowerment if estás holding anything in either hand other than a single one-handed arma, other implements, or esoterica, and debes be holding at least one implement to gain the benefit.

feat->Exploit Vulnerability.name: Explotar la vulnerabilidad
feat->Exploit Vulnerability.description:
Tú know that every criatura, no matter how obscure, has a weakness. By identifying and empowering the right object, puedes strike down even the most resilient of monsters.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fodJ3zuwQsYnBbtk]{Exploit Vulnerability} action.

Puedes attempt to Exploit Vulnerabilities in one of two ways: either by invoking properties that repel that type of criatura, or by attempting a more improvisational, ad-hoc method with tu esoterica that can impose a custom weakness on any criatura, albeit one that usually isn't as dire as a criatura's existing weakness.

Mortal Weakness After identifying a criatura's weakness, tú use a thematically resonant bit of esoterica to attune tu attacks to tu discovery. Tu unarmed and arma Golpes activate the highest weakness tú discovered with Exploit Vulnerability, even though the tipo de daño tu arma deals doesn't change. Este daño affects el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability, as well as any other criaturas of the exact same type, but not other criaturas with the same weakness. For example, when fighting a pack of werewolves, tú might use silver shavings or crushed moonstone to deal daño that applies their weakness to silver to tu attacks against any of the werewolves, but tú wouldn't apply this daño to any other monsters with a weakness to silver.

Personal Antithesis Tú improvise a custom weakness on a criatura by forcefully presenting and empowering a piece of esoterica that repels it on an individual level; for instance, against a tyrant, tú might procure a broken chain that once held a captive. Este causes el objetivo criatura, and only el objetivo criatura, to gain a weakness against tu unarmed and arma Golpes equal to 2 + half tu level.

feat->Lantern.name: Linterna
feat->Lantern.description:
Lantern implements shine the light of revelation to part shadows and expose truth. Tú might use a common glass lantern, torch, paper lantern, or other similar light source. Lantern implements are associated with the harrow suit of stars and the astrological signs of the lantern bearer and the archer.

Tu lantern's light flares and burns bright, leaving no shadows in which secrets and enemies can hide. The emanation of tu lantern's aura doubles in size. Against el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability, the status bonuses from the lantern's initiate benefit increase to +2. The criatura takes a –2 penalización de estado to DECEPTION checks and STEALTH checks as long as it's within the aura. Additionally, el objetivo of tu Exploit Vulnerability can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} while it's in the lantern's aura, though it still can potentially become hidden or undetected using cover or means other than the concealed condition.

feat->Initiate Beneficio (Lantern).description:
While tú hold tu lantern, its burning light leaves secrets no place to hide. Puedes light or extinguish tu lantern with nothing but a thought, as a free action that has the concentrate rasgo. While lit, the lantern emits an aura of light in a 20-pies emanation; the aura has the light and magical rasgos. Everything in the aura is magically lit with bright light regardless of cover, and dim light extends beyond the aura an additional distance equal to the size of the aura. The aura's counteract rank against magical darkness is equal to half tu level rounded up.

The lantern's aura attempts to reveal the unseen. Tú and tu allies in the lantern's aura gain a +1 bonificador de estado to visual Perception checks to notice anything that is also within the aura and a +1 bonificador de estado to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} against criaturas within the aura, as the light exposes their true natures. During exploration, even if tú aren't Searching, the GM rolls a secret check for tú to find traps, environmental hazards, haunts, and secrets (such as secret doors). The GM rolls each time a given hazard or secret comes within the lantern's aura. Estos effects have the magical and revelation rasgos.

When tú Golpe, puedes trace mystic patterns with an implement estás holding to empower the Golpe, causing it to deal 2 additional Damage per arma dado de daño. Channeling the power requires full use of tu hands. Tú don't gain the benefit of implement's empowerment if estás holding anything in either hand other than a single one-handed arma, other implements, or esoterica, and debes be holding at least one implement to gain the benefit.

feat->Divine Spark and Ikons.name: Divine Spark and Ikons
feat->Divine Spark and Ikons.description:
Within tu soul is a tiny spark of divine power that belongs not to a deity, but is something has claimed all tu own. Puedes focus this divine power through special items known as ikons. Ikons are items or bodily features intrinsically linked to tú—sacred vessels forged from tu divinity that are capable of conducting its power.

By placing tu divine spark into one of tu ikons, tú empower that ikon to accomplish deeds beyond what it could in mortal hands. Each ikon has both a passive immanence effect and an active transcendence effect. Both of these effects require tu divine spark to be in the item. Puedes place tu spark into an ikon by using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9cGJBXSJW6EpgibP]{Shift Immanence} action.

Spark Transcendence

While tu spark dwells within an ikon, tú get that ikon's immanence effect continually. However, puedes also Spark Transcendence in a mighty deed, channeling tu divinity through the ikon—though when tú Spark Transcendence, the force of the act temporarily casts tu divine spark out of the ikon. Each ikon's transcendence action appears in its stat block, and the transcendence rasgo is described in the Key Terms sidebar.

Expanding Immanence And Transcendence

Each ikon has one immanence and one transcendence ability when acquired, but puedes imbue tu ikons with additional abilities through higher-level exemplar class features and feats. Estos abilities have the ikon rasgo.

Ikons

As an exemplar, tú select three ikons at first level. Typically, tú will want to ensure at least one of tu ikons is a arma. Body ikons accentuate a physical rasgo of tu body and so can't be stolen, disarmed, dispelled, or otherwise taken away. Weapon and worn ikons are tied to items of power. When tú select one, obtienes a non-magical, level-0 item of tu choice that matches its usage entry. Providence ensures tú come across these items; tú might be traveling along a path to find a spear in a tree that only puedes dislodge, or tú might awaken holding a gleaming sash tú saw in tu dreams.

Tu ikons can be etched with runes, upgraded, or otherwise modified as normal for items of their type. A body or worn ikon can have runes etched on it to apply to tu ataques sin armas as though it were handwraps of mighty blows, though only one of tu ikons can have these runes and no ikon can have both these and armor or arma runes.

If tú acquire a new item the ikon's usage could apply to, puedes switch tu ikon to the new item by spending 1 day of downtime with the new ikon as tú saturate the object with tu divine energy. Puedes use this process to make an existing magic item, like a cloak of illusions or a searing blade, into tu ikon. If the item wasn't already a divine item, it becomes one for as long as it is tu ikon, removing the arcane, occult, primal, or magical rasgo from the item and adding the divine rasgo. Artifacts, intelligent items, and other similarly powerful objects might resist tu attempts to exert tu divinity over them, with unpredictable results determined by the GM.

feat->Divine Spark and Ikons.name: Divine Spark and Ikons
feat->Divine Spark and Ikons.description:
Within tu soul is a tiny spark of divine power that belongs not to a deity, but is something has claimed all tu own. Puedes focus this divine power through special items known as ikons. Ikons are items or bodily features intrinsically linked to tú—sacred vessels forged from tu divinity that are capable of conducting its power.

By placing tu divine spark into one of tu ikons, tú empower that ikon to accomplish deeds beyond what it could in mortal hands. Each ikon has both a passive immanence effect and an active transcendence effect. Both of these effects require tu divine spark to be in the item. Puedes place tu spark into an ikon by using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9cGJBXSJW6EpgibP]{Shift Immanence} action.

Spark Transcendence

While tu spark dwells within an ikon, tú get that ikon's immanence effect continually. However, puedes also Spark Transcendence in a mighty deed, channeling tu divinity through the ikon—though when tú Spark Transcendence, the force of the act temporarily casts tu divine spark out of the ikon. Each ikon's transcendence action appears in its stat block, and the transcendence rasgo is described in the Key Terms sidebar.

Expanding Immanence And Transcendence

Each ikon has one immanence and one transcendence ability when acquired, but puedes imbue tu ikons with additional abilities through higher-level exemplar class features and feats. Estos abilities have the ikon rasgo.

Ikons

As an exemplar, tú select three ikons at first level. Typically, tú will want to ensure at least one of tu ikons is a arma. Body ikons accentuate a physical rasgo of tu body and so can't be stolen, disarmed, dispelled, or otherwise taken away. Weapon and worn ikons are tied to items of power. When tú select one, obtienes a non-magical, level-0 item of tu choice that matches its usage entry. Providence ensures tú come across these items; tú might be traveling along a path to find a spear in a tree that only puedes dislodge, or tú might awaken holding a gleaming sash tú saw in tu dreams.

Tu ikons can be etched with runes, upgraded, or otherwise modified as normal for items of their type. A body or worn ikon can have runes etched on it to apply to tu ataques sin armas as though it were handwraps of mighty blows, though only one of tu ikons can have these runes and no ikon can have both these and armor or arma runes.

If tú acquire a new item the ikon's usage could apply to, puedes switch tu ikon to the new item by spending 1 day of downtime with the new ikon as tú saturate the object with tu divine energy. Puedes use this process to make an existing magic item, like a cloak of illusions or a searing blade, into tu ikon. If the item wasn't already a divine item, it becomes one for as long as it is tu ikon, removing the arcane, occult, primal, or magical rasgo from the item and adding the divine rasgo. Artifacts, intelligent items, and other similarly powerful objects might resist tu attempts to exert tu divinity over them, with unpredictable results determined by the GM.

feat->Root Epithet.name: Epiteto raiz
feat->Root Epithet.description:
As tu story unfolds, tu personality and deeds begin to shape the potential of tu divine spark. Tu epithets grant tú additional abilities, especially when tu divine spark is brought to the surface.

Tú first gain a root epithet to describe an aspect of tu personality. Este grants tú a skill, as well as a special effect that occurs when tú Spark Transcendence. If estás already entrenado in the granted skill, tú become entrenado in a different skill of tu choice, as normal. An effect that occurs after tú Spark Transcendence happens immediately after tu transcendence action is completely resolved.

feat->Methodology.name: Metodología
feat->Methodology.description:
Tu studies have made tú savvy in many areas, but one in particular drew tu intense interest. Elige a methodology. The methodologies are as follows:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ln2Y1a4SxlU9sizX]{Alchemical Sciences Methodology}

feat->Devise a Stratagem.name: Diseñar una estratagema
feat->Devise a Stratagem.description:
Puedes play out a battle in tu head, using brains rather than brawn to execute an attack.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} action.

action->Pursue a Lead.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]

Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Tú name one detail has identified that tú think is part of a larger mystery, then spend 1 minute examining it. The detail is typically either obvious or something has already discovered using Recall Knowledge, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, Gather Information, or a similar action. After the minute passes, the GM either confirms there's a larger mystery or tells tú there's nothing more to learn (the detail is inconsequential or tú know all the information already). If there is in fact a larger mystery at play, puedes't Pursue a Lead again for 10 minutes, but puedes elige to open an investigation. To do so, define the question at the heart of the mystery, such as "Where has the priceless work of art that was supposed to hang here been taken?" or "Who or what killed this priest?" Work with tu GM to refine the question if need be. Puedes also give tu investigation a name to better keep track of it (such as "The Case of the Cheated Goblin" or "The Skinsaw Murders").

Investigation Bonus Siempre que tú attempt a Perception check or prueba de habilidad to attempt to get closer to answering the question at the heart of an active investigation, obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to the check. The exact checks this applies to depend on the actions tú use to investigate and are determined by the GM, but checks to investigate are typically Perception checks or pruebas de habilidad that use INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, or Charisma.

Active Investigations Puedes maintain two active investigations at a time. If tú Pursue another Lead after that, the case must be different from any of tu current investigations (as far as estás aware), and tú give up on a current investigation of tu choice. Once has given up pursuit of an investigation, puedes't Pursue a Lead into it again until after the next time tú make tu daily preparations.

Solving an Investigation If tú answer the question at the heart of tu investigation, the GM tells tú that has done so. Tú don't lose the bonus or other benefits until tú elige to close the investigation by Pursuing a Lead again or voluntarily Dismissing it. If what tú discover points to an even larger mystery, puedes work with the GM to adapt the question and name of the investigation to the new information.

feat->Empiricism Methodology.name: Metodología del empirismo
feat->Empiricism Methodology.description:
Everything comes down to data. Calculating statistics, running numbers, and using inductive reasoning allows tú to determine the most likely outcome of any scenario, and anything out of place draws tu keen attention.

Estás entrenado in one INTELLIGENCE-based skill of tu choice. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pIHjH1x0AVtiX5Tv]{That's Odd} investigator feat, and obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jftNJjBNxp2cleoi]{Expeditious Inspection} free action.

action->Devise a Stratagem.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Tú assess a foe's weaknesses in combat and use them to formulate a plan of attack. Elige a criatura puedes see. Puedes Devise a Stratagem as a free action if estás aware that criatura could help answer the question at the heart of one of tu active investigations. Roll a d20, then decide on an attack stratagem or skill stratagem.

Attack Stratagem If tú Golpe the chosen criatura before the start of tu next turn, debes use the result of the d20 roll for tu Golpe's tirada de ataque instead of rolling. Tú make this substitution only for the first Golpe tú make against the criatura this round, not any subsequent ones. When tú make this substitution, puedes add tu INTELLIGENCE modifier to tu tirada de ataque instead of tu Strength or Dexterity modifier, provided tú Golpe with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma (which must be agile or finesse if it's a melee arma with the thrown rasgo), or a sap.

Skill Stratagem Puedes't attempt to Golpe el objetivo until the start of tu next turn. Obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to tu next INTELLIGENCE-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based prueba de habilidad or Perception check involving el objetivo before the start of tu next turn. If tú would gain tu Pursue a Lead investigation bonus to such a check, that bonus increases by 1 instead of tú gaining the +1 bonus listed.

feat->Strategic Strike.name: Strategic Golpe
feat->Strategic Strike.description:
When tú strike carefully and with forethought, tú deal a telling blow. When making a Golpe that adds tu INTELLIGENCE modifier on tu tirada de ataque due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.lgo65ldX7WkXC8Ir]{Devising a Stratagem}, tú deal an additional 1d6 daño de precisión.

As tu investigator level increases, so too does the deadliness of tu strategic strike. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

consumable->Forensic Dye.description:
Activar 1 INTERACT

Activating this vial of colorless liquid requires inserting a small amount of another chemical or material, such as blood or mud. The vial reacts rapidly, transforming into a murky, reddish-brown substance.

action->Pursue a Lead.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]

Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Tú name one detail has identified that tú think is part of a larger mystery, then spend 1 minute examining it. The detail is typically either obvious or something has already discovered using Recall Knowledge, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, Gather Information, or a similar action. After the minute passes, the GM either confirms there's a larger mystery or tells tú there's nothing more to learn (the detail is inconsequential or tú know all the information already). If there is in fact a larger mystery at play, puedes't Pursue a Lead again for 10 minutes, but puedes elige to open an investigation. To do so, define the question at the heart of the mystery, such as "Where has the priceless work of art that was supposed to hang here been taken?" or "Who or what killed this priest?" Work with tu GM to refine the question if need be. Puedes also give tu investigation a name to better keep track of it (such as "The Case of the Cheated Goblin" or "The Skinsaw Murders").

Investigation Bonus Siempre que tú attempt a Perception check or prueba de habilidad to attempt to get closer to answering the question at the heart of an active investigation, obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to the check. The exact checks this applies to depend on the actions tú use to investigate and are determined by the GM, but checks to investigate are typically Perception checks or pruebas de habilidad that use INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, or Charisma.

Active Investigations Puedes maintain two active investigations at a time. If tú Pursue another Lead after that, the case must be different from any of tu current investigations (as far as estás aware), and tú give up on a current investigation of tu choice. Once has given up pursuit of an investigation, puedes't Pursue a Lead into it again until after the next time tú make tu daily preparations.

Solving an Investigation If tú answer the question at the heart of tu investigation, the GM tells tú that has done so. Tú don't lose the bonus or other benefits until tú elige to close the investigation by Pursuing a Lead again or voluntarily Dismissing it. If what tú discover points to an even larger mystery, puedes work with the GM to adapt the question and name of the investigation to the new information.

feat->Empiricism Methodology.description:
Everything comes down to data. Calculating statistics, running numbers, and using inductive reasoning allows tú to determine the most likely outcome of any scenario, and anything out of place draws tu keen attention.

Estás entrenado in one INTELLIGENCE-based skill of tu choice. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pIHjH1x0AVtiX5Tv]{That's Odd} investigator feat, and obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jftNJjBNxp2cleoi]{Expeditious Inspection} free action.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Tú assess a foe's weaknesses in combat and use them to formulate a plan of attack. Elige a criatura puedes see. Puedes Devise a Stratagem as a free action if estás aware that criatura could help answer the question at the heart of one of tu active investigations. Roll a d20, then decide on an attack stratagem or skill stratagem.

Attack Stratagem If tú Golpe the chosen criatura before the start of tu next turn, debes use the result of the d20 roll for tu Golpe's tirada de ataque instead of rolling. Tú make this substitution only for the first Golpe tú make against the criatura this round, not any subsequent ones. When tú make this substitution, puedes add tu INTELLIGENCE modifier to tu tirada de ataque instead of tu Strength or Dexterity modifier, provided tú Golpe with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma (which must be agile or finesse if it's a melee arma with the thrown rasgo), or a sap.

Skill Stratagem Puedes't attempt to Golpe el objetivo until the start of tu next turn. Obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to tu next INTELLIGENCE-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based prueba de habilidad or Perception check involving el objetivo before the start of tu next turn. If tú would gain tu Pursue a Lead investigation bonus to such a check, that bonus increases by 1 instead of tú gaining the +1 bonus listed.

As tu investigator level increases, so too does the deadliness of tu strategic strike. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Invocation of Sight (1st): Tú shift tu eyes easily to the spirit world, intuiting the needs of apparitions and other spiritual entities based on how they appear to tú. Obtienes spirit resistance and void resistance equal to half tu level, and tu bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación and AC against the effects of haunts and the abilities of spirits and incorporeal undead increases to +2.

feat->Apparition Attunement.name: Sintonía con Apariciones
feat->Apparition Attunement.description:
Animists have a gift for divine magic that allows them to serve as conduits or bridges for otherworldly spiritual entities known collectively as apparitions; through them, these entities can commune and INTERACT with the physical world in a process called attunement. Apparitions are myriad and diverse: they may be human spirits lingering on the border between becoming phantoms or ghosts, animal spirits with particularly strong connections to the physical world but lacking the malice that would spur a transition into true undeath, manifestations of natural locations that have grown thought and purpose over time, or they may be a different variation altogether.

Some animists attune to one or more specific apparitions that accompany them in their travels, forming deep partnerships over time, while others adapt to their surroundings by befriending the local apparitions who dwell wherever the animist's journey takes them. Each day during tu daily preparations, elige two apparitions from the list on page 17 to attune to. Of these, elige one to be tu primary apparition. Tu attuned apparitions each grant tú knowledge in the form of LORE skills and a repertoire of additional conjuros puedes cast using apparition spellcasting (see below), and tu primary apparition grants tú even further power in the form a unique vessel focus conjuro and, when estás higher level, a unique avatar form.

When tú Refocus, puedes change which of tu currently attuned apparitions is tu primary apparition, selecting from any of the apparitions tú attuned to during tu daily preparations. All tu apparitions typically remain attuned to tú until tu next daily preparations, but some animist abilities can temporarily disperse them, usually in exchange for a powerful boon. If an apparition is dispersed, tú lose access to its gifts—tú forget its apparition skills, its conjuros are removed from tu apparition conjuro repertoire, and puedes't use its vessel conjuro or avatar form—until tú attune to it again. When tú disperse tu primary apparition, one of tu remaining apparitions becomes tu primary apparition, chosen by tú at the time of dispersal.

feat->Animist & Apparition Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de animista y aparición
feat->Animist & Apparition Spellcasting.description:
Tu role as a spiritual medium connecting the mortal Universe to the realms beyond lets tú cast tu magic in two distinct ways: tú both learn and prepare conjuros from the divine tradition yourself, and tú also channel the knowledge and power of tu attuned apparitions, gaining conjuro slots and a repertoire of conjuros from them that puedes cast spontaneously.

Regardless of which source estás drawing on, estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As an animist, tu incantations might take the form of reciting relevant snippets of legends—stories passed down orally—or they might see tú calling nearby spirits to honor ancient vows. Tu gestures could be elegant dances or full-body convulsions as generations of memories and otherworldly energies inherited from tu spiritual allies surge through tú.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifiers and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

The clearly delineated partnership between an animist and their apparitions means puedes't cast tu animist conjuros using tu apparition conjuro slots or vice versa—tu magics remain complementary and harmonious, yet as distinct as the two worlds from which they come.

Animist Spellcasting

As a keeper of knowledge, estás constantly learning new techniques and conjuros. Each day, puedes prepare one 1st-rank conjuro and 2 cantrips from among the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list or from other divine conjuros has gained access to and learned via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots. As tú increase in level as an animist, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in Animist Spells Per Day.

Estás a prepared spellcaster for the purposes of determining how tú INTERACT with staves and other items or effects that differentiate between prepared and spontaneous spellcasters.

Apparition Spellcasting

Puedes draw upon tu attuned apparitions as a second source of magical knowledge and power. Obtienes additional spontaneous conjuro slots and a conjuro repertoire from tu attuned apparitions. At first level, puedes cast two apparition cantrips and one 1st-rank apparition conjuro per day. Debes have the conjuro in tu apparition conjuro repertoire to cast it; this is a collection of conjuros granted to tú by all tu attuned apparitions. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu apparition conjuro repertoire by using an apparition conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Any of these conjuros that aren't normally on the divine list are still divine conjuros if tú cast them this way.

As tú increase in level, obtienes further apparition conjuro slots, and tu apparitions grant tú higher-rank apparition conjuros, as detailed in each apparition entry.

Heightening Spells

When obtienes conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. All tu apparition conjuros are signature conjuros. That means that puedes heighten any apparition conjuro freely by casting it from a higher-rank apparition conjuro slot, up to the maximum rank of apparition conjuro puedes cast.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of animist conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level animist, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level animist, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

Vessel Spells

Tu primary attuned apparition can use tu body as a conduit, allowing tú to cast a unique vessel conjuro. Vessel conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. Because vessel conjuros are a manifestation of a specific apparition, an animist can't cast or Sustain a specific vessel conjuro in the same round they have already cast or Sustained it (for example, an animist who has cast earth's bile during their turn can't then cast or Sustain another instance of earth's bile during that same turn).

It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to treat with nearby spirits, meditate on resolving an issue pertaining to the balance of spirits and mortals, or tell a story.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, though certain feats or abilities adjust this number, but it can never be more than 3 points.

feat->Deity (Champion).name: Deidad (Campeón)
feat->Deity (Champion).description:
As a champion, estás a warrior in the name of a deity tú revere above all others. Elige one deity.

Skill

Quedas entrenado in the divine skill listed for tu deity. As normal, if estás already entrenado in that skill, tú become entrenado in a different skill of tu choice.

Anathema

Champions care deeply about the edicts and anathema they take from their deity, sanctification, and cause. As with any implementation of edicts and anathema in the rules, these are a tool for roleplaying between tú, the GM, and the other players at the table—estás still playing a nuanced character, not strictly following a script.

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Similarly, using items, conjuros, or actions that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, assisting with a ritual that raises undead would be anathema to Pharasma, the goddess of death. Many actions that are anathema don't appear in any deity's formal list. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu holy or unholy rasgo, tu focus pool, and tu blessing of the devoted. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual. If tu deity doesn't require the specific sanctification tú had, tu GM might let tú retrain tu sanctification and cause while still following the same deity.

Sanctification

Depending on tu deity, their sanctification can make tú holy or unholy. Este commits tú to one side of a struggle over souls. Whether tú become holy, unholy, or neither will limit tu choice of causes, devotion conjuros, and feats.

If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity's sanctification entry, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy, obtienes the rasgo automatically. If the deity lists "none," puedes elige only options that don't require the holy or unholy rasgo. If estás holy or unholy and gain the opposing rasgo in some way, tú lose the previous rasgo until tú atone.

Unholy sanctification for a champion can be extremely disruptive to a typical game and should be a player character option only in appropriate adventures or campaigns where the group collectively decides to embrace them. Unholy sanctification and causes are uncommon options.

Holy: Obtienes the holy rasgo and add that rasgo to any Golpes tú make. Obtienes the edict, "Do not knowingly harm innocents or fail to prevent harm to an innocent if tu direct intervention could save them" and the anathema "Commit murder." Even if tu game includes behavior outside the Pathfinder baseline, the acts listed there are anathema to tú.

Unholy: Obtienes the unholy rasgo and add that rasgo to any Golpes tú make. Obtienes the edict, "Do not put another's needs before tu own or those of tu deity" and the anathema "Commit an entirely altruistic act, such as giving something away in charity" and "Put anyone's needs before those of tu deity." None of these prevents tú from performing acts others might consider helpful, but these acts must be done with the expectation that they ultimately further tu own goals or those of tu deity

feat->Devotion Spells.description:
Tu deity's power grants tú special divine conjuros called devotion conjuros, which are a type of focus conjuro. Elige either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL97DcoJ8us6EwAF]{Shields of the Spirit} or a conjuro based on tu deity's divine font (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} if tu deity allows heal, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jFmWSIpJGGebim6y]{Touch of the Void} if tu deity allows harm).

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but can never be more than 3 points.

feat->Blessing of the Devoted.description:
Tu deity blesses tu service with a boon. Este might come in the form of a spirit that visits tú and inhabits tu items or body, a mysterious divine tattoo upon tu body, or the like. Elige one of the following blessings, or any other to which tienes access.

Blessed Armament: Select one arma or handwraps of mighty blows. Obtienes that armament's critical specialization effect, and tú grant the armament a property rune of tu choice from the following list: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.P6v2AtJw7AUwaDzf]{Fearsome}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.roeYtwlIe65BPMJ1]{Shifting}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{Vitalizing}. During tu daily preparations, puedes change the spirit to inhabit a different armament, grant a different rune, or both.

Blessed Shield: In tu hands, a shield gains the minor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.x9SNVpAAnXKJeoqp]{Reinforcing} rune. As tú go up in level, the shield gains the reinforcing rune of tu level (lesser at 7th level, moderate at 10th level, greater at 13th level, major at 16th level, and supreme at 19th level). If tu shield already has the appropriate reinforcing rune for tu level, or if it's a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f9ygr5Cjrmop8LWV]{Sturdy Shield} of the same level as the appropriate reinforcing rune, the shield's Hardness instead increases by 1.

Blessed Swiftness: Obtienes a +5-pies bonificador de estado to Velocidad. If estás mounted, tu mount gains the bonus instead. In addition, when the movement of one of tu allies triggers an enemigo's reaction while the ally is in tu champion's aura, the ally gains a +2 bonificador de estado to all defenses against that reaction.

As a champion, estás a warrior in the name of a deity tú revere above all others. Elige one deity.

Skill

Quedas entrenado in the divine skill listed for tu deity. As normal, if estás already entrenado in that skill, tú become entrenado in a different skill of tu choice.

Anathema

Champions care deeply about the edicts and anathema they take from their deity, sanctification, and cause. As with any implementation of edicts and anathema in the rules, these are a tool for roleplaying between tú, the GM, and the other players at the table—estás still playing a nuanced character, not strictly following a script.

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Similarly, using items, conjuros, or actions that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, assisting with a ritual that raises undead would be anathema to Pharasma, the goddess of death. Many actions that are anathema don't appear in any deity's formal list. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu holy or unholy rasgo, tu focus pool, and tu blessing of the devoted. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual. If tu deity doesn't require the specific sanctification tú had, tu GM might let tú retrain tu sanctification and cause while still following the same deity.

Sanctification

Depending on tu deity, their sanctification can make tú holy or unholy. Este commits tú to one side of a struggle over souls. Whether tú become holy, unholy, or neither will limit tu choice of causes, devotion conjuros, and feats.

If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity's sanctification entry, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy, obtienes the rasgo automatically. If the deity lists "none," puedes elige only options that don't require the holy or unholy rasgo. If estás holy or unholy and gain the opposing rasgo in some way, tú lose the previous rasgo until tú atone.

Unholy sanctification for a champion can be extremely disruptive to a typical game and should be a player character option only in appropriate adventures or campaigns where the group collectively decides to embrace them. Unholy sanctification and causes are uncommon options.

Holy: Obtienes the holy rasgo and add that rasgo to any Golpes tú make. Obtienes the edict, "Do not knowingly harm innocents or fail to prevent harm to an innocent if tu direct intervention could save them" and the anathema "Commit murder." Even if tu game includes behavior outside the Pathfinder baseline, the acts listed there are anathema to tú.

Unholy: Obtienes the unholy rasgo and add that rasgo to any Golpes tú make. Obtienes the edict, "Do not put another's needs before tu own or those of tu deity" and the anathema "Commit an entirely altruistic act, such as giving something away in charity" and "Put anyone's needs before those of tu deity." None of these prevents tú from performing acts others might consider helpful, but these acts must be done with the expectation that they ultimately further tu own goals or those of tu deity

feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.
