Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same level. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-level conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher levels.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. The tradition from which tu conjuros come is determined by tu bloodline. As a sorcerer, tú draw tu power from within, and the gestures and incantations tú use to shape tu power might evoke the NATURE of tu bloodline. For instance, a sorcerer with a demonic bloodline might chant guttural fiendish phrases or make brief curt gestures to cast a conjuro.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the sorcerer Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast it in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of sorcerer conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots; puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but can never be more than 3 points. The full rules are on page 298 of Player Core. Aprendes the initial bloodline conjuro, which is unique to tu bloodline.

feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same level. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-level conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher levels.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. The tradition from which tu conjuros come is determined by tu bloodline. As a sorcerer, tú draw tu power from within, and the gestures and incantations tú use to shape tu power might evoke the NATURE of tu bloodline. For instance, a sorcerer with a demonic bloodline might chant guttural fiendish phrases or make brief curt gestures to cast a conjuro.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the sorcerer Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast it in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of sorcerer conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same level. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-level conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher levels.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Sorcerous Potency.name: Potencia Hechicera
feat->Sorcerous Potency.description: Because of the magical power inherent in tu blood, tu conjuros that hurt or cure are stronger than those of other spellcasters. When tú Lanzar un conjuro from tu conjuro slots that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, obtienes a bonificador de estado to that conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank. Este applies only to the initial daño or healing the conjuro deals when cast. An individual criatura takes this daño or benefits from this healing only once per conjuro, even if the conjuro would daño or heal that criatura multiple times.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. The tradition from which tu conjuros come is determined by tu bloodline. As a sorcerer, tú draw tu power from within, and the gestures and incantations tú use to shape tu power might evoke the NATURE of tu bloodline. For instance, a sorcerer with a demonic bloodline might chant guttural fiendish phrases or make brief curt gestures to cast a conjuro.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the sorcerer Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast it in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of sorcerer conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots; puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but can never be more than 3 points. The full rules are on page 298 of Player Core. Aprendes the initial bloodline conjuro, which is unique to tu bloodline.

Reading a Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information.

Tradition Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Sorcerous Gifts Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.lURKSJZAGKVD6cH9]{Spell Repertoire} feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using a Focus Point or a sorcerous gift conjuro using a conjuro slot, tú elige one blood magic effect tú know to benefit from. Tú begin play with the benefit listed in tu bloodline and can gain others through sorcerer feats.

If the blood magic effect offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. If the conjuro has an area, debes designate yourself or one target in the area when tú cast the conjuro to be el objetivo of the blood magic effect. All references to conjuro rank refer to the rank of the conjuro tú cast.

feat->Signature Spells.description: Experience allows tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

feat->Unleash Psyche.name: Libera la psique
feat->Unleash Psyche.description: When one thins the barrier between their inner mind and the outer world, one can unleash true psychic power. However, the mind wasn't meant to tap its full strength for long, leading to backlash once tu unleashed psyche ends.

feat->Subconscious Mind.name: Mente inconsciente
feat->Subconscious Mind.description:
A psychic's power is born in the depths of their psyche, far from the surface. Tu subconscious mind might represent the way tu power comes to tú naturally, or it may be a framework tú use to safely access the infinite potential of tu mind. Either way, tu subconscious mind fundamentally shapes how tú access and wield psychic magic. Elige a subconscious mind from the options below. Este choice will determine tu key attribute, thoughtforms tú use while casting, and an action puedes take while tienes Unleashed tu Psyche. The following options are presented in this book.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNihL10QAB1sYSRn]{Emotional Acceptance} (Cha): Throwing yourself headlong into tu emotions is what lets tú access tu power.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0UKDEtZ7ffTEsqCK]{Gathered LORE} (Int): Tutors taught tú specific axioms and lessons to help tú harness tu mind.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Qrhw4SILfT8YNQgB]{Precise Discipline} (Int): Meticulously aligning tu thoughts brings tu mental power into reality.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.EMErBnhrgUHEKAsZ]{Wandering Reverie} (Cha): Tu imagination fuels tu magic through instinct and free association.

feat->Conscious Mind.name: Mente consciente
feat->Conscious Mind.description:
Whatever the subconscious source of a psychic's power, all find that a specific external manifestation of their magic comes most easily to them. Este conscious outward expression adds several additional conjuros to tu conjuro repertoire and grants tú three psi cantrips. Two of these cantrips are common conjuros, though obtienes an extra benefit with them that other spellcasters don't get, and the last is unique to tu conscious mind. Tú also get two more unique psi cantrips at higher levels. Elige a conscious mind from the following options.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.1rlBo3LcwIuPDCvz]{The Distant Grasp}: Manipulate physical objects with telekinesis.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.rvpTsj9epRuNH3uB]{The Infinite Eye}: Observe the world and weaponize tu knowledge.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5tSR0WzMPFn5s3Xs]{The Oscillating Wave}: Redistribute thermal energy to create blazing heat and bone-chilling cold.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.rdWWlqvxXgfWDaSO]{The Silent Whisper}: Tap into the thoughts of those around tú to soothe or influence.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8dAm3ULUqaK4N5a7]{The Tangible Dream}: Weave tu imagination into creations of force and light.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.FaSY47siV1x6CAQp]{The Unbound Dar un paso}: Bend and traverse space with teleportation and phasing.

feat->Psychic Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de hechizos psíquicos
feat->Psychic Spellcasting.description:
Tú access the vast well of power that resides within tu own mind, calling forth psychic magic with nothing but thought and will. Estás a spellcaster and can cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. Tú don't need to utter incantations to cast tu conjuros, instead exerting tu mind toward tu intended effect as described in tu subconscious mind class feature. Tu conjuros still have clear and noticeable visual and auditory manifestations, as normal for a spellcaster.

Each day, puedes cast one 1st-rank conjuro. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a psychic, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is determined by tu subconscious mind, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use the modifier for the attribute stated in tu subconscious mind.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of psychic conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level psychic, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level psychic, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

As a psychic, tú get the ability to improve some of tu cantrips with special benefits and psi amps. Over the course of tu career, tu choice of conscious mind class feature gives tú extra cantrips, benefits and psi amps for cantrips, and a collection of unique psi cantrips.

feat->Psi Cantrips and Amps.description:

Like other cantrips, puedes cast psi cantrips as often as tú like, and they are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Tu psi cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige from the occult list as part of tu psychic spellcasting. Generally, only feats can give tú more psi cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out psi cantrips gained from psychic feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining. At 1st level, tú learn three psi cantrips determined by tu choice of conscious mind; one is a unique psi cantrip and two are common cantrips, typically from the occult spellcasting tradition, that tú always cast as psi cantrips. Tú automatically gain more psi cantrips as tú progress in tu career as a psychic.

Tú start with a focus pool of 2 Focus Points. However, unlike other spellcasters, tú don't gain focus conjuros that cost Focus Points to cast. Instead, tú use tu Focus Points to boost or modify tu psi cantrips by applying amps—specialized thoughtforms that alter the expression of tu psychic power. Each of tu psi cantrips has a special amp heading. Siempre que tú cast a psi cantrip, puedes amp it by spending 1 Focus Point as a free action. If the next action sufres is to cast the psi cantrip, tú add the amp effect. Puedes also gain additional amps through feats, allowing tú to substitute a psi cantrip's normal amp effect for another one. Tú elige which amp to use, if tú elige to use any, each time tú cast a psi cantrip. Unless otherwise noted, puedes apply only one amp to a given psi cantrip.

Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain Focus Points by spending 10 minutes using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} activity to explore tu mind, whether via meditation, practicing a craft or activity that gives tú the mental space to self-reflect, or talking through tu thoughts and feelings with yourself or another. If has spent Focus Points on focus conjuros or abilities other than those from the psychic class (for instance, to cast a focus conjuro tú gained from an archetype), tú regain only 1 Focus Point.

Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Puedes then attempt to [[/act create-a-diversion]] as usual. Those criaturas who disbelieved the illusion aren't affected by this diversion. Tu figment also gains the following amp.

Amp When tú amp the conjuro, puedes create a particularly distracting illusion as part of its normal effects. Elige an unoccupied square within the conjuro's range. The illusion in that square provides flanking for a single melee attack made before the beginning of tu next turn. If tú Sustain the conjuro, the details of the illusion change and shift to keep tu enemies unsettled; the flanking illusion's duration extends until the beginning of tu next turn and puedes move it to any unoccupied square in the conjuro's range. The flanking illusion can't provide its benefit against any criatura who has disbelieved the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}

Tu shield conjuro can be deployed on behalf of others. When tú cast shield, puedes elige a target ally within 30 pies to gain the benefits of the conjuro instead of tú. The option to Shield Block with the conjuro is up to tú and uses tu reaction, not el objetivo's. Tu shield also gains the following amp.

Amp Creas a layered barrier of three shields to improve tu defenses. The duration increases to sustained up to 1 minute. The shield still lowers at the start of each of tu turns, but puedes raise it again when tú Sustain the Spell.

When tú Shield Block with this conjuro, one of the three layers breaks and tú cease to gain the bonus to AC, but the conjuro doesn't end. Puedes keep using the conjuro until the final layer breaks; once it does, the conjuro ends and puedes't cast shield or amped shield again for 10 minutes. Puedes elige to break additional layers when tú Shield Block with this conjuro to improve tu defenses. If tú break two layers instead of one, increase the Hardness to 1-1/2 × the normal amount (7 at 1st rank, 15 at 3rd rank, 22 at 5th rank, 30 at 7th rank, and 37 at 9th rank). If tú break all three layers, increase the Hardness to double the normal amount.

deepest: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wykbu2KW9tMBRySr]{Hologram Cage}

Amp Force walls make the cage's barrier physical as well as visual. Each 10-pies-by-10-pies section of the cage's wall has AC 10, Hardness equal to double the conjuro's rank, and HP equal to quadruple the conjuro's rank. The conjuro is disrupted if any of its walls would pass through a criatura when tú cast it.

feat->Psychic Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de hechizos psíquicos
feat->Psychic Spellcasting.description:
Tú access the vast well of power that resides within tu own mind, calling forth psychic magic with nothing but thought and will. Estás a spellcaster and can cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. Tú don't need to utter incantations to cast tu conjuros, instead exerting tu mind toward tu intended effect as described in tu subconscious mind class feature. Tu conjuros still have clear and noticeable visual and auditory manifestations, as normal for a spellcaster.

Each day, puedes cast one 1st-rank conjuro. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a psychic, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is determined by tu subconscious mind, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use the modifier for the attribute stated in tu subconscious mind.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of psychic conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level psychic, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level psychic, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

As a psychic, tú get the ability to improve some of tu cantrips with special benefits and psi amps. Over the course of tu career, tu choice of conscious mind class feature gives tú extra cantrips, benefits and psi amps for cantrips, and a collection of unique psi cantrips.

feat->Psi Cantrips and Amps.name: Trucos psi y amplificadores
feat->Psi Cantrips and Amps.description:
The magic of tu mind manifests as psi cantrips, which puedes modify by spending Focus Points. Like other cantrips, puedes cast psi cantrips as often as tú like, and they are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Tu psi cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige from the occult list as part of tu psychic spellcasting. Generally, only feats can give tú more psi cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out psi cantrips gained from psychic feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining. At 1st level, tú learn three psi cantrips determined by tu choice of conscious mind; one is a unique psi cantrip and two are common cantrips, typically from the occult spellcasting tradition, that tú always cast as psi cantrips. Tú automatically gain more psi cantrips as tú progress in tu career as a psychic.

Tú start with a focus pool of 2 Focus Points. However, unlike other spellcasters, tú don't gain focus conjuros that cost Focus Points to cast. Instead, tú use tu Focus Points to boost or modify tu psi cantrips by applying amps—specialized thoughtforms that alter the expression of tu psychic power. Each of tu psi cantrips has a special amp heading. Siempre que tú cast a psi cantrip, puedes amp it by spending 1 Focus Point as a free action. If the next action sufres is to cast the psi cantrip, tú add the amp effect. Puedes also gain additional amps through feats, allowing tú to substitute a psi cantrip's normal amp effect for another one. Tú elige which amp to use, if tú elige to use any, each time tú cast a psi cantrip. Unless otherwise noted, puedes apply only one amp to a given psi cantrip.

Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain Focus Points by spending 10 minutes using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} activity to explore tu mind, whether via meditation, practicing a craft or activity that gives tú the mental space to self-reflect, or talking through tu thoughts and feelings with yourself or another. If has spent Focus Points only to amp psi cantrips or fuel psychic abilities since the last time tú Refocused, tú regain 2 Focus Points instead of 1. If has spent Focus Points on focus conjuros or abilities other than those from the psychic class (for instance, to cast a focus conjuro tú gained from an archetype), tú regain only 1 Focus Point.

feat->Spell Repertoire.name: Repertorio de conjuros
feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Psychic Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-rank conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher ranks.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same ranks. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description: Has learned to cast some of tu conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

consumable->Scroll of Illusory Disguise.consumableSpellDescription:
Creas an illusion that causes el objetivo to appear as another criatura of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The conjuro changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. Puedes change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the criatura returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of DECEPTION; it ignores any circumstance penalties el objetivo might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar criatura, gives a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets el objetivo add its level to such DECEPTION checks even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss this conjuro.

Heightened (3rd) El objetivo can appear as any criatura of the same size, even a specific individual. Debes have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) Puedes target up to 10 willing criaturas. If tú target multiple criaturas, puedes elige a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. Puedes Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but puedes elige disguises that impersonate specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

feat->Unleash Psyche.name: Libera la psique
feat->Unleash Psyche.description: When one thins the barrier between their inner mind and the outer world, one can unleash true psychic power. However, the mind wasn't meant to tap its full strength for long, leading to backlash once tu unleashed psyche ends.

feat->Subconscious Mind.name: Mente inconsciente
feat->Subconscious Mind.description:
A psychic's power is born in the depths of their psyche, far from the surface. Tu subconscious mind might represent the way tu power comes to tú naturally, or it may be a framework tú use to safely access the infinite potential of tu mind. Either way, tu subconscious mind fundamentally shapes how tú access and wield psychic magic. Elige a subconscious mind from the options below. Este choice will determine tu key attribute, thoughtforms tú use while casting, and an action puedes take while tienes Unleashed tu Psyche. The following options are presented in this book.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNihL10QAB1sYSRn]{Emotional Acceptance} (Cha): Throwing yourself headlong into tu emotions is what lets tú access tu power.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0UKDEtZ7ffTEsqCK]{Gathered LORE} (Int): Tutors taught tú specific axioms and lessons to help tú harness tu mind.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Qrhw4SILfT8YNQgB]{Precise Discipline} (Int): Meticulously aligning tu thoughts brings tu mental power into reality.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.EMErBnhrgUHEKAsZ]{Wandering Reverie} (Cha): Tu imagination fuels tu magic through instinct and free association.

feat->Conscious Mind.name: Mente consciente
feat->Conscious Mind.description:
Whatever the subconscious source of a psychic's power, all find that a specific external manifestation of their magic comes most easily to them. Este conscious outward expression adds several additional conjuros to tu conjuro repertoire and grants tú three psi cantrips. Two of these cantrips are common conjuros, though obtienes an extra benefit with them that other spellcasters don't get, and the last is unique to tu conscious mind. Tú also get two more unique psi cantrips at higher levels. Elige a conscious mind from the following options.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.1rlBo3LcwIuPDCvz]{The Distant Grasp}: Manipulate physical objects with telekinesis.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.rvpTsj9epRuNH3uB]{The Infinite Eye}: Observe the world and weaponize tu knowledge.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5tSR0WzMPFn5s3Xs]{The Oscillating Wave}: Redistribute thermal energy to create blazing heat and bone-chilling cold.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.rdWWlqvxXgfWDaSO]{The Silent Whisper}: Tap into the thoughts of those around tú to soothe or influence.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8dAm3ULUqaK4N5a7]{The Tangible Dream}: Weave tu imagination into creations of force and light.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.FaSY47siV1x6CAQp]{The Unbound Dar un paso}: Bend and traverse space with teleportation and phasing.

Specific conjuros tú learn come from tu conscious mind, which shapes the raw psychic power from tu subconscious into the forms and phenomena that tú intentionally cast. Tú select tu conscious mind at 1st level, and it detemines the following.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, in addition to those obtienes through psychic spellcasting. At 1st level, obtienes a 1st-rank conjuro, and tú learn the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast psychic conjuros of that rank, learning the 2nd-rank conjuro at 3rd level, the 3rd-rank conjuro at 5th level, and so on.

Standard Psi Cantrips Estos are two common cantrips tú automatically gain at 1st level. While these are the same cantrips used by other spellcasters, tú cast them as psi cantrips, enabling tú to amp them for greater effect. Tu mastery of psychic magic also grants tú a passive benefit that applies every time tú cast these cantrips, even when tú haven't amped them. Estos benefits apply only with cantrips obtienes from tu conscious mind; tú would cast a cantrip tú gained with tu psychic spellcasting class feature, for example, as normal even if it appears in a different conscious mind.

Unique Psi Cantrips Estos psi cantrips are unique to tu conscious mind. Tú automatically gain the surface psi cantrip at 1st level, automatically gain the deeper psi cantrip at 6th level, and automatically gain the deepest psi cantrip at 10th level.

feat->Wandering Reverie.name: Ensueño errante
feat->Wandering Reverie.description:
The subconscious is by definition buried below the surface. Thus, only by stripping away the clamor and interference of everyday thought can tú bring this more fundamental part of tu mind to bear. Whether through sleep, self-hypnosis, or special exercises to empty tu mind, has found a way to access a deeper, more chaotic state of free association that better channels tu psychic power.

Tu thoughtforms come from tu imagination, images, and sensations tu mind freely associates. Tú might have a passing daydream of small criaturas bringing tú an object as tú telekinetically attract it or tú may blink to find has teleported to tu desired location. Spell manifestations from imagination thoughtforms have surreal or indistinct qualities, and the exact details fade quickly from observers' memory, as sensations from a dream.

Key Attribute Tu key attribute score is Charisma.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}

Tu minor illusions shift and dance in a way that draws the eye. The range of figment increases to 60 pies. When tú Sustain the conjuro, puedes move the apparent sound or vision up to 15 pies. Puedes then attempt to [[/act create-a-diversion]] as usual. Those criaturas who disbelieved the illusion aren't affected by this diversion. Tu figment also gains the following amp.

Amp When tú amp the conjuro, puedes create a particularly distracting illusion as part of its normal effects. Elige an unoccupied square within the conjuro's range. The illusion in that square provides flanking for a single melee attack made before the beginning of tu next turn. If tú Sustain the conjuro, the details of the illusion change and shift to keep tu enemies unsettled; the flanking illusion's duration extends until the beginning of tu next turn and puedes move it to any unoccupied square in the conjuro's range. The flanking illusion can't provide its benefit against any criatura who has disbelieved the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}

Tu shield conjuro can be deployed on behalf of others. When tú cast shield, puedes elige a target ally within 30 pies to gain the benefits of the conjuro instead of tú. The option to Shield Block with the conjuro is up to tú and uses tu reaction, not el objetivo's. Tu shield also gains the following amp.

Amp Creas a layered barrier of three shields to improve tu defenses. The duration increases to sustained up to 1 minute. The shield still lowers at the start of each of tu turns, but puedes raise it again when tú Sustain the Spell.

When tú Shield Block with this conjuro, one of the three layers breaks and tú cease to gain the bonus to AC, but the conjuro doesn't end. Puedes keep using the conjuro until the final layer breaks; once it does, the conjuro ends and puedes't cast shield or amped shield again for 10 minutes. Puedes elige to break additional layers when tú Shield Block with this conjuro to improve tu defenses. If tú break two layers instead of one, increase the Hardness to 1-1/2 × the normal amount (7 at 1st rank, 15 at 3rd rank, 22 at 5th rank, 30 at 7th rank, and 37 at 9th rank). If tú break all three layers, increase the Hardness to double the normal amount.

Unique Psi Cantrips
