deeper: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nUSi2B7RhIKjaiXQ]{Astral Rain}

Amp The area changes to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5], and puedes Sustain the Spell up to 1 minute. The first time each round that tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move the burst up to 20 pies.

deepest: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wykbu2KW9tMBRySr]{Hologram Cage}

Amp Force walls make the cage's barrier physical as well as visual. Each 10-pies-by-10-pies section of the cage's wall has AC 10, Hardness equal to double the conjuro's rank, and HP equal to quadruple the conjuro's rank. The conjuro is disrupted if any of its walls would pass through a criatura when tú cast it.

feat->Psychic Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de hechizos psíquicos
feat->Psychic Spellcasting.description:
Tú access the vast well of power that resides within tu own mind, calling forth psychic magic with nothing but thought and will. Estás a spellcaster and can cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. Tú don't need to utter incantations to cast tu conjuros, instead exerting tu mind toward tu intended effect as described in tu subconscious mind class feature. Tu conjuros still have clear and noticeable visual and auditory manifestations, as normal for a spellcaster.

Each day, puedes cast one 1st-rank conjuro. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a psychic, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is determined by tu subconscious mind, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use the modifier for the attribute stated in tu subconscious mind.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of psychic conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level psychic, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level psychic, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

As a psychic, tú get the ability to improve some of tu cantrips with special benefits and psi amps. Over the course of tu career, tu choice of conscious mind class feature gives tú extra cantrips, benefits and psi amps for cantrips, and a collection of unique psi cantrips.

feat->Psi Cantrips and Amps.name: Trucos psi y amplificadores
feat->Psi Cantrips and Amps.description:
The magic of tu mind manifests as psi cantrips, which puedes modify by spending Focus Points. Like other cantrips, puedes cast psi cantrips as often as tú like, and they are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Tu psi cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige from the occult list as part of tu psychic spellcasting. Generally, only feats can give tú more psi cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out psi cantrips gained from psychic feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining. At 1st level, tú learn three psi cantrips determined by tu choice of conscious mind; one is a unique psi cantrip and two are common cantrips, typically from the occult spellcasting tradition, that tú always cast as psi cantrips. Tú automatically gain more psi cantrips as tú progress in tu career as a psychic.

Tú start with a focus pool of 2 Focus Points. However, unlike other spellcasters, tú don't gain focus conjuros that cost Focus Points to cast. Instead, tú use tu Focus Points to boost or modify tu psi cantrips by applying amps—specialized thoughtforms that alter the expression of tu psychic power. Each of tu psi cantrips has a special amp heading. Siempre que tú cast a psi cantrip, puedes amp it by spending 1 Focus Point as a free action. If the next action sufres is to cast the psi cantrip, tú add the amp effect. Puedes also gain additional amps through feats, allowing tú to substitute a psi cantrip's normal amp effect for another one. Tú elige which amp to use, if tú elige to use any, each time tú cast a psi cantrip. Unless otherwise noted, puedes apply only one amp to a given psi cantrip.

Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain Focus Points by spending 10 minutes using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} activity to explore tu mind, whether via meditation, practicing a craft or activity that gives tú the mental space to self-reflect, or talking through tu thoughts and feelings with yourself or another. If has spent Focus Points only to amp psi cantrips or fuel psychic abilities since the last time tú Refocused, tú regain 2 Focus Points instead of 1. If has spent Focus Points on focus conjuros or abilities other than those from the psychic class (for instance, to cast a focus conjuro tú gained from an archetype), tú regain only 1 Focus Point.

feat->Spell Repertoire.name: Repertorio de conjuros
feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Psychic Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-rank conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher ranks.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same ranks. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description: Has learned to cast some of tu conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

Puedes change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the criatura returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of DECEPTION; it ignores any circumstance penalties el objetivo might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar criatura, gives a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets el objetivo add its level to such DECEPTION checks even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss this conjuro.

Heightened (3rd) El objetivo can appear as any criatura of the same size, even a specific individual. Debes have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) Puedes target up to 10 willing criaturas. If tú target multiple criaturas, puedes elige a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. Puedes Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but puedes elige disguises that impersonate specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

feat->Tactics.name: Tactics
feat->Tactics.description:
By studying and practicing the strategic arts of war, puedes guide tu allies to victory. Tú begin play with a folio containing five tactics. Estos are combat techniques and coordinated maneuvers puedes instruct tu allies in, enabling them to respond to tu signals in combat. As tú increase in level, obtienes the ability to learn more potent tactics. When obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZvsiPWL9mVZk5Tz1]{Expert Tactician} class feature, obtienes the ability to add experto tactics to tu folio; when obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wHVfwjs6LJOgDERO]{Master Tactician} class feature, puedes add maestro tactics to tu folio; and when obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.jMxFu2vsw9ZOw61O]{Legendary Tactician} class feature, puedes add legendario tactics to tu folio.

Preparing and Changing Tactics

Each day during tu daily preparations, tú prepare three tactics from tu folio and drill in them alongside tu allies, enabling tú to use these tactics until tu next daily preparations. When tú drill, puedes instruct a total number of allies equal to 2 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier, enabling these allies to respond to tu tactics in combat. Estos allies are tu squadmates. A squadmate always has the option not to respond to tu tactical signal if they do not wish to. Tú count as one of tu squadmates for the purposes of participating in or benefiting from a tactic (though tú do not count against tu own maximum number of squadmates). The tactics rasgo is explained in more detail in the key terms sidebar on this page.

Puedes change which tactics tienes prepared from those in tu folio by spending 10 minutes to drill, replacing all previously prepared tactics and squadmates. Este does not prevent tu allies from performing their own activities during this time frame. Some tactics have a limited usage, such as the Valkyrie's Charge tactic, which can be used una vez al día. Estos tactics can never exceed their indicated use limit even if tú replace them with a different tactic and then prepare them again later that same day, but puedes replace a tactic whose limited use has been expended with another tactic tú know any time estás able to change tu prepared tactics.

Gaining New Tactics

Tú add additional tactics to tu folio and increase the number of tactics puedes prepare when obtienes the experto tactician, maestro tactician, and legendario tactician class features. Puedes also add tactics to tu folio with the Tactical Expansion feat, though this does not change the number puedes have prepared. Because tactics folios use shorthand and signals unique to each commander, there is typically no benefit to using (or stealing) another commander's folio, though puedes train with another commander to retrain one tactic in tu folio to another that they know.

feat->Commander's Banner.name: Commander's Banner
feat->Commander's Banner.description:
A commander needs a battle standard to help guide their allies on the field. Tú start play with a custom banner that puedes use to signal allies when using tactics (see below) or to deploy specific abilities. Tu banner can be affixed to a arma or shield estás wielding, attached to a simple pole or handle and held in one hand, or worn affixed to a pole alongside tu backpack. Tu banner might be a literal flag or pennant, a decorated fan, a personalized totem, or some other highly visible and item of negligible or light Bulk. Tu banner requires customization and influences tu allies' morale, so puedes have only one banner at a time designated as tu commander's banner; designating a new banner or standard as tu commander's banner takes 1 minute.

As long as tu banner is visible and in tu possession, it provides an aura that gives tú and all allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] a +1 bonificador de estado to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. Puedes pause or resume this effect as part of any action tú would typically use to stow or retrieve tu banner. If tu banner is destroyed or stolen, allies currently benefiting from its bonuses become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}. Este effect has the aura, emotion, mental, and visual rasgos.

Some abilities allow tú to place tu banner in a specialized manner, such as the Commander's Companion and Plant Banner feats. As long as tienes placed tu banner in this way, any banner abilities originate from tu banner's space instead of tu own, and obtienes the same basic benefits as when it is in tu possession. An unattended banner has the base Hardness and Puntos de Golpe of a standard item of its type (usually cloth, thin leather, or thin wood) or the Hardness and Puntos de Golpe of the object it is affixed to, whichever is greater.

feat->Tactics.name: Tactics
feat->Tactics.description:
By studying and practicing the strategic arts of war, puedes guide tu allies to victory. Tú begin play with a folio containing five tactics. Estos are combat techniques and coordinated maneuvers puedes instruct tu allies in, enabling them to respond to tu signals in combat. As tú increase in level, obtienes the ability to learn more potent tactics. When obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZvsiPWL9mVZk5Tz1]{Expert Tactician} class feature, obtienes the ability to add experto tactics to tu folio; when obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wHVfwjs6LJOgDERO]{Master Tactician} class feature, puedes add maestro tactics to tu folio; and when obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.jMxFu2vsw9ZOw61O]{Legendary Tactician} class feature, puedes add legendario tactics to tu folio.

Preparing and Changing Tactics

Each day during tu daily preparations, tú prepare three tactics from tu folio and drill in them alongside tu allies, enabling tú to use these tactics until tu next daily preparations. When tú drill, puedes instruct a total number of allies equal to 2 + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier, enabling these allies to respond to tu tactics in combat. Estos allies are tu squadmates. A squadmate always has the option not to respond to tu tactical signal if they do not wish to. Tú count as one of tu squadmates for the purposes of participating in or benefiting from a tactic (though tú do not count against tu own maximum number of squadmates). The tactics rasgo is explained in more detail in the key terms sidebar on this page.

Puedes change which tactics tienes prepared from those in tu folio by spending 10 minutes to drill, replacing all previously prepared tactics and squadmates. Este does not prevent tu allies from performing their own activities during this time frame. Some tactics have a limited usage, such as the Valkyrie's Charge tactic, which can be used una vez al día. Estos tactics can never exceed their indicated use limit even if tú replace them with a different tactic and then prepare them again later that same day, but puedes replace a tactic whose limited use has been expended with another tactic tú know any time estás able to change tu prepared tactics.

Gaining New Tactics

Tú add additional tactics to tu folio and increase the number of tactics puedes prepare when obtienes the experto tactician, maestro tactician, and legendario tactician class features. Puedes also add tactics to tu folio with the Tactical Expansion feat, though this does not change the number puedes have prepared. Because tactics folios use shorthand and signals unique to each commander, there is typically no benefit to using (or stealing) another commander's folio, though puedes train with another commander to retrain one tactic in tu folio to another that they know.

  • Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
  • Increase its ataque sin armas daño from one die to two dice (for instance, 1d8 to 2d8).
  • Increase its proficiency rank for Perception and all tiradas de salvación to experto.
  • Increase its proficiency ranks in INTIMIDATION, STEALTH, and SURVIVAL to entrenado. If the construct is tu innovation and it was already entrenado in those skills from a modification, increase its proficiency rank in those skills to experto.
  • Puedes change tu companion's Size, if tú want, to either Small, Medium, or Large.

feat->Kinetic Aura.name: Aura cinética
feat->Kinetic Aura.description:
Through tu kinetic gate, elements flow from an elemental plane to orbit tu person. The form and appearance of this kinetic aura are unique to tú. Examples include a chaotic wind orbiting the body, fragments of floating gravel, colorful wicks of flame stars of raw metal always changing shape, floatin snowflakes or splinters dancing in the air. If puedes channel more than one element, pieces of all tu kinetic elements appear in the aura.

Tienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.g8QrV39TmZfkbXgE]{Channel Elements} action, which lets tú activate tu kinetic aura.

feat->Kinetic Gate.name: Puerta cinética
feat->Kinetic Gate.description:
As a kineticist, has awakened or opened a kinetic gate, a supernatural conduit within tu body that can channel elemental forces straight from the elemental planes. Puedes elige either a single gate (one element) or dual gate (two elements) at 1st level.

When selecting an element for tu kinetic gate, puedes pick from six elements - air, earth, fire metal, water, and wood. Elements puedes channel are referred to as tu kinetic elements. Tu kinetic elements function even in environments where they normally wouldn't. For example, tú could use fire actions underwater even though that's normally not possible, and tú could create air in a vacuum.

Tu kinetic gate gives tú impulse feats, magical actions that let tú shape and control tu elements in awesome ways. Puedes select more impulse feats using tu kineticist class feats, as described under Impulses. At higher levels, the gate's threshold class feature gives tú more impulse feats and lets tú elige whether to improve with one element or access new kinetic elements.

Single Gate

Tu kinetic gate links to a single elemental plane, starting tú with a single element but giving tú greater power with it. Elige one element to be tu kinetic element, and select two 1st-level impulse feats that have that element's rasgo.

In addition, obtienes an impulse junction, a benefit that occurs when tú use an impulse of the chosen element that takes 2 actions or more. Este happens before the other effects of the impulse, unless noted otherwise. Puedes gain only one impulse junction per round; they are described in full below.

Air Before or after the other effects of the impulse, puedes either Zancada up to half tu Velocidad or Dar un paso. If tienes a fly Velocidad, puedes Fly up to half tu fly Velocidad instead.

Earth Fragments of stone float around tú, granting tú a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the start of tu next turn.

Fire Increase the dado de daño size of daño de fuego dealt by the impulse by one step.

Metal Elige acid, electricity, or piercing. Until the start of tu next turn, each time a criatura touches tú or damages tú with an unarmed melee attack or nonreach melee arma, it takes daño of the chosen type equal to half tu level (minimum 1 daño).

Water After the impulse's other effects, puedes move one criatura targeted by the impulse or in its area 5 pies in any direction, or 10 pies if it's in a body of water. Este can't move the criatura into the air. Puedes elige only a criatura that's willing to be moved, that failed its save against the impulse, or that tú succeeded at an impulse tirada de ataque against.

Wood Obtienes Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to tu level that last until the start of tu next turn.

Dual Gate

Tu kinetic gate is a harmonious conduit between two planes, allowing tú to combine their elements to give tú a versatile set of abilities. Select two elements to be tu kinetic elements. Then, select two 1st-level impulse feats, one with the rasgo of the first element and one with the rasgo of the other.

feat->Impulses.name: Impulsos
feat->Impulses.description:
An impulse is a special type of magical action available to kineticists, allowing them to wield or shape their element into diverse and powerful forms. To wield an element, debes have tu kinetic aura active and have a free hand, as described in the impulse rasgo. Tú automatically gain the Elemental Blast and Base Kinesis impulses, and tu kinetic gate selection gives tú additional impulse feats. Puedes select more impulse feats with kineticist class feats, and at higher levels, tú'll automatically get more with the gate's threshold class feature. Puedes select an impulse feat only if it matches one of tu kinetic elements.

Impulses are magical, and though they aren't conjuros, some things that affect conjuros also affect impulses. Abilities that restrict tú from casting conjuros (such as being polymorphed into a battle form) or protect against conjuros (such as a conjuro that protects against other conjuros or a criatura's bonus to saves against conjuros) also apply to impulses.

Impulse Levels

Any impulse tú use is the same level estás. For instance, if estás 5th level, tu Elemental Blast would be 5th level (and its counteract rank would be 3rd rank), even though tú gained the action at 1st level.

Similar to conjuros, many impulses get more powerful as tú increase in level. In these cases, the impulse ends with one or more "Level" entries. Este either lists the levels at which the impulse gets an upgrade or has an entry with a plus sign that describes a benefit that increases on a regular basis. For instance, a 1st-level impulse with a "Level (+4)" entry would get stronger at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Impulse Attacks and DCs

An impulse that requires a tirada de salvación uses tu kineticist CLASS DC. Some of tu impulses require tú to attempt an impulse tirada de ataque to see how effective they are. Tu impulse tirada de ataque uses the same proficiency and attribute modifier as tu kineticist CLASS DC. Like a conjuro attack modifier, tu impulse attack modifier uses the following formula: d20 roll + attribute modifier + proficiency bonus + other bonuses + penalties. Este means tu impulse tirada de ataque is typically 10 lower than tu CLASS DC. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition can reduce tu impulse tiradas de ataque and class DCs. Puedes acquire a gate attenuator to gain a bonus to tu impulse attack modifier.

Elemental Blast

The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6lbr0Jnv0zMB5uGb]{Elemental Blast} impulse is a simple expression of tu power, allowing tú to attack with the pure matter of tu kinetic element. Though each element has its own strengths and weaknesses, the basic principles to using them are the same. Puedes customize the appearance of tu Elemental Blast and can even elige a different form each time tú use the impulse.

Base Kinesis

The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nTBrvt2b9wngyr0i]{Base Kinesis} impulse lets tú perform simple alterations to an element.

feat->Fire Gate.name: Puerta de fuego
feat->Fire Gate.description:
Fire Gate Junction

consumable->Healing Potion (Minor).description:
Activar A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain [[/r 1d8[healing]]]{1d8 Puntos de Golpe}.

feat->Kinetic Aura.name: Aura cinética
feat->Kinetic Aura.description:
Through tu kinetic gate, elements flow from an elemental plane to orbit tu person. The form and appearance of this kinetic aura are unique to tú. Examples include a chaotic wind orbiting the body, fragments of floating gravel, colorful wicks of flame stars of raw metal always changing shape, floatin snowflakes or splinters dancing in the air. If puedes channel more than one element, pieces of all tu kinetic elements appear in the aura.

Tienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.g8QrV39TmZfkbXgE]{Channel Elements} action, which lets tú activate tu kinetic aura.

feat->Kinetic Gate.name: Puerta cinética
feat->Kinetic Gate.description:
As a kineticist, has awakened or opened a kinetic gate, a supernatural conduit within tu body that can channel elemental forces straight from the elemental planes. Puedes elige either a single gate (one element) or dual gate (two elements) at 1st level.

When selecting an element for tu kinetic gate, puedes pick from six elements - air, earth, fire metal, water, and wood. Elements puedes channel are referred to as tu kinetic elements. Tu kinetic elements function even in environments where they normally wouldn't. For example, tú could use fire actions underwater even though that's normally not possible, and tú could create air in a vacuum.

Tu kinetic gate gives tú impulse feats, magical actions that let tú shape and control tu elements in awesome ways. Puedes select more impulse feats using tu kineticist class feats, as described under Impulses. At higher levels, the gate's threshold class feature gives tú more impulse feats and lets tú elige whether to improve with one element or access new kinetic elements.

Single Gate

Tu kinetic gate links to a single elemental plane, starting tú with a single element but giving tú greater power with it. Elige one element to be tu kinetic element, and select two 1st-level impulse feats that have that element's rasgo.

In addition, obtienes an impulse junction, a benefit that occurs when tú use an impulse of the chosen element that takes 2 actions or more. Este happens before the other effects of the impulse, unless noted otherwise. Puedes gain only one impulse junction per round; they are described in full below.

Air Before or after the other effects of the impulse, puedes either Zancada up to half tu Velocidad or Dar un paso. If tienes a fly Velocidad, puedes Fly up to half tu fly Velocidad instead.

Earth Fragments of stone float around tú, granting tú a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the start of tu next turn.

Fire Increase the dado de daño size of daño de fuego dealt by the impulse by one step.

Metal Elige acid, electricity, or piercing. Until the start of tu next turn, each time a criatura touches tú or damages tú with an unarmed melee attack or nonreach melee arma, it takes daño of the chosen type equal to half tu level (minimum 1 daño).

Water After the impulse's other effects, puedes move one criatura targeted by the impulse or in its area 5 pies in any direction, or 10 pies if it's in a body of water. Este can't move the criatura into the air. Puedes elige only a criatura that's willing to be moved, that failed its save against the impulse, or that tú succeeded at an impulse tirada de ataque against.

Wood Obtienes Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to tu level that last until the start of tu next turn.

Dual Gate

Tu kinetic gate is a harmonious conduit between two planes, allowing tú to combine their elements to give tú a versatile set of abilities. Select two elements to be tu kinetic elements. Then, select two 1st-level impulse feats, one with the rasgo of the first element and one with the rasgo of the other.

feat->Impulses.name: Impulsos
feat->Impulses.description:
An impulse is a special type of magical action available to kineticists, allowing them to wield or shape their element into diverse and powerful forms. To wield an element, debes have tu kinetic aura active and have a free hand, as described in the impulse rasgo. Tú automatically gain the Elemental Blast and Base Kinesis impulses, and tu kinetic gate selection gives tú additional impulse feats. Puedes select more impulse feats with kineticist class feats, and at higher levels, tú'll automatically get more with the gate's threshold class feature. Puedes select an impulse feat only if it matches one of tu kinetic elements.

Impulses are magical, and though they aren't conjuros, some things that affect conjuros also affect impulses. Abilities that restrict tú from casting conjuros (such as being polymorphed into a battle form) or protect against conjuros (such as a conjuro that protects against other conjuros or a criatura's bonus to saves against conjuros) also apply to impulses.

Impulse Levels

Any impulse tú use is the same level estás. For instance, if estás 5th level, tu Elemental Blast would be 5th level (and its counteract rank would be 3rd rank), even though tú gained the action at 1st level.

Similar to conjuros, many impulses get more powerful as tú increase in level. In these cases, the impulse ends with one or more "Level" entries. Este either lists the levels at which the impulse gets an upgrade or has an entry with a plus sign that describes a benefit that increases on a regular basis. For instance, a 1st-level impulse with a "Level (+4)" entry would get stronger at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Impulse Attacks and DCs

An impulse that requires a tirada de salvación uses tu kineticist CLASS DC. Some of tu impulses require tú to attempt an impulse tirada de ataque to see how effective they are. Tu impulse tirada de ataque uses the same proficiency and attribute modifier as tu kineticist CLASS DC. Like a conjuro attack modifier, tu impulse attack modifier uses the following formula: d20 roll + attribute modifier + proficiency bonus + other bonuses + penalties. Este means tu impulse tirada de ataque is typically 10 lower than tu CLASS DC. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition can reduce tu impulse tiradas de ataque and class DCs. Puedes acquire a gate attenuator to gain a bonus to tu impulse attack modifier.

Elemental Blast

The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6lbr0Jnv0zMB5uGb]{Elemental Blast} impulse is a simple expression of tu power, allowing tú to attack with the pure matter of tu kinetic element. Though each element has its own strengths and weaknesses, the basic principles to using them are the same. Puedes customize the appearance of tu Elemental Blast and can even elige a different form each time tú use the impulse.

Base Kinesis

The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nTBrvt2b9wngyr0i]{Base Kinesis} impulse lets tú perform simple alterations to an element.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]

With a sudden shout, a well-timed taunt, or a cutting put-down, puedes shake an enemigo's resolve. Elige a criatura within 30 pies of tú who estás aware of. Attempt an INTIMIDATION check against that target's Will DC. If el objetivo doesn't understand the language estás speaking, or estás not speaking a language, sufres a –4 penalización de circunstancia to the check. Regardless of tu result, el objetivo is temporarily immune to tu attempts to DEMORALIZE it for 10 minutes.

Éxito crítico El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Éxito El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

feat->Gate's Threshold (Expand the Porta.name: Gate's Threshold (Expand the Portal: Fire)
feat->Gate's Threshold (Expand the Porta.description:
Tú reach a new milestone in tu odyssey to become in tune with tu kinetic gate and must decide how to expand the gate's power. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, tú elige to either expand the portal or fork the path.

  • Expand the Portal: Tu gate attunes more precisely to one of tu elements. Gain an impulse feat of tu level or lower for one of tu kinetic elements; if tienes more than one element, puedes elige a composite impulse. Tú also gain a gate junction for one of tu kinetic elements. If tienes no valid options for the feat-typically because tienes one kinetic element and devoted tu class feats to gaining that element's impulses-puedes instead select any kineticist class feat of tu level or lower for which tú meet the prerequisites.
  • Fork the Path: Tu gate reaches to another elemental plane. Add a new element of tu choice to tu kinetic elements. Gain an impulse feat of tu level or lower with the rasgo of that element. Puedes't select a composite impulse feat with this feat selection.

feat->Gate Junction (Critical Blast).name: Gate Junction (Critical Blast)
feat->Gate Junction (Critical Blast).description:
Gate Junctions

When obtienes a gate junction, tú develop a specialized kinetic technique. Elige one benefit from the gate junction table for one of tu kinetic elements.

  • A critical blast junction happens when tú get a critical success with an Elemental Blast of the kinetic element.
  • An elemental resistance grants tú resistance to daño while tu kinetic aura is active. Este resistance is equal to tu level, and it applies to daño of any listed type or that comes from a criatura or effect that has any of the listed rasgos. At 17th level, obtienes immunity to effects with any of the listed rasgos. Este doesn't make tú immune to criaturas with such a rasgo. Puedes voluntarily forgo this resistance, immunity, or both if tú want an effect to work on tú.
  • Puedes elige an impulse junction instead of one of the listed junctions. Impulse junctions are listed under Single Gate.
  • An aura junction adds an effect to tu kinetic aura when tú Channel Elements.
  • A skill junction makes tú entrenado in the listed skill and grants tú the listed skill feat. If tú were already entrenado in the listed skill, tú instead become entrenado in a skill of tu choice. While tu kinetic aura is active, obtienes a +1 bonificador de estado to the listed skill; the bonus increases to +2 at 10th level and +3 at 17th level.

Puedes select each gate junction only once, unless noted otherwise, but puedes have the same type of junction for multiple elements. Puedes always elige not to use a gate junction when it would normally occur. If tienes multiple junctions that would apply at the same time - such as kinetic aura junctions for different elements - puedes apply any number of them. (Though note that puedes use only one impulse junction per round.)
